items.title: Anthropic negocia un acuerdo de US$45.000 millones con Nscale para ampliar su capacidad de cómputo
items.author: Bailey Lipschultz, Dina Bass, Brody Ford
items.summary: La operación podría incluir 460 megavatios de potencia de cálculo con chips Vera Rubin de Nvidia en Virginia Occidental. Las negociaciones siguen en curso y aún no hay una decisión definitiva.
items.body: Bloomberg — Nscale Ltd., la empresa de computación en la nube basada en inteligencia artificial, está en negociaciones para vender potencia de cálculo a Anthropic PBC en una operación que podría ascender a unos US$45.000 millones, según fuentes familiarizadas con las negociaciones. El desarrollador de centros de datos, respaldado por Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ), busca cerrar un segundo acuerdo importante con la empresa creadora de Claude para una segunda instalación en su complejo de centros de datos Monarch, en Virginia Occidental, según indicaron dichas fuentes. Anthropic tiene acuerdos en vigor con Nscale para una infraestructura cuyo valor asciende a unos US$44.600 millones, según un documento presentado ante las autoridades reguladoras en relación con la oferta pública inicial prevista por Nscale. Ver más: Anthropic planea destinar el 5% de sus acciones a un fondo de beneficio público El segundo edificio de Monarch proporcionaría 460 megavatios de potencia de cálculo, utilizando los avanzados chips de IA Vera Rubin de Nvidia, según indicaron algunas de estas fuentes. Anthropic también cuenta con el derecho de tanteo sobre el tercer edificio previsto en Monarch, añadieron. El acuerdo podría cerrarse en los próximos días, según indicaron las fuentes, que solicitaron mantener el anonimato dado que las negociaciones son privadas. Las deliberaciones siguen en curso, los detalles del plan podrían cambiar y aún no se ha tomado ninguna decisión definitiva, añadieron las fuentes. Los representantes de Anthropic y Nscale se negaron a hacer comentarios. Otro acuerdo informático de varios miles de millones de dólares reforzaría las perspectivas de salida a bolsa de Nscale, ya que la empresa aspira a alcanzar una valoración de unos US$30.000 millones en su debut en el mercado. Según ha informado Bloomberg News, un grupo de inversores instó a la empresa a rebajar su objetivo de valoración para la salida a bolsa. Ver más: Anthropic habría presentado proyecto de ley para frenar modelos de IA que amenacen vidas o causen daños Anthropic, que es uno de los principales clientes de Nscale, se ha convertido en un cliente clave para los proveedores de centros de datos en general. Entre los acuerdos que ha firmado figuran un pacto de US$50.000 millones con Fluidstack Ltd., otro de US$10.000 millones con la startup de infraestructuras Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. y uno de US$45.000 millones con SpaceX ( SPCX ), de Elon Musk. El campus Monarch de Nscale en Virginia Occidental tendrá una capacidad ampliable a más de 8 gigavatios de potencia bruta una vez finalizado, según muestran los documentos presentados para la salida a bolsa. En un principio, se esperaba que Microsoft Corp. ( MSFT ) alquilara parte del campus Monarch, ya que la empresa había anunciado en marzo que había firmado una carta de intenciones para el centro de datos previsto. Sin embargo, Microsoft renunció al emplazamiento de Virginia Occidental en verano, lo que permitió a Anthropic convertirse en el arrendatario, según informó Bloomberg News. Se espera que Anthropic, cuya valoración ascendió a US$965.000 millones en mayo, lleve a cabo su propia salida a bolsa —que podría batir récords— en los próximos meses, y sigue buscando más potencia de cálculo para seguir creciendo. Ver más: Anthropic se perfila como la gran apuesta ante la pausa de las salidas a bolsa en EE.UU. Los inversores se muestran cada vez más recelosos ante las enormes sumas que se están pidiendo prestadas para financiar el auge de los centros de datos de IA, lo que ha provocado un desánimo generalizado, desde las acciones de los fabricantes de chips hasta la deuda de las empresas de computación en la nube. Nscale presentó públicamente su solicitud de cotización en EE.UU. en septiembre y aún no ha iniciado la comercialización formal, a pesar de que ya ha transcurrido el periodo de espera obligatorio de 15 días. La empresa está analizando las observaciones de la Comisión de Valores y Bolsa de EE.UU. (SEC) sobre su solicitud y tiene la intención de iniciar la comercialización una vez que se hayan resuelto dichas observaciones, según han afirmado fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto. La empresa recaudó US$3.360 millones en una ronda de financiación previa a la salida a bolsa el mes pasado, en una operación liderada por Third Point, de Dan Loeb, en la que participaron inversores como Nvidia, Apollo Global Management Inc. ( APO ), Citadel, Hudson Bay Capital y el Consejo de Inversiones de Abu Dabi. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Promit Mukherjee

[オタワ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Promit Mukherjee

[オタワ １９日 ロイター] - カナダ統計局が１９日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月比上昇率が３．１％となり、カナダ銀行（中央銀行）のインフレ目標圏（１―３％）を３カ月ぶりに上回った。ガソリンとディーゼル燃料（軽油）の価格高騰が全体を押し上げた。

ロイターがアナリストらに調査した市場予想は３．２％、８月は３．０％だった。

・９月のＣＰＩの前月比は０．１％上昇。８月は０．１％下落していた。

・カナダ銀行は今月２８日の次回会合で政策金利を２．２５％に据え置くとの見方が優勢。１２月には２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが織り込まれている。

・カナダ銀行のティフ・マックレム総裁は、今月２８日に発表する四半期のインフレ見通しを大幅に引き上げる見込みを明らかにしている。

・９月のＣＰＩの前年同月比が上昇したのは、エネルギー価格が１９％上昇したことが主因。ガソリン価格は２７．８％上がった。ガソリン価格の影響を除いたインフレ率は２．２％となり、８月の２．４％から縮小した。

・９月の食品のインフレ率は１．７％で２０２４年５月以来、２年４カ月ぶりの低水準。

・住居費のインフレ率は１．８％、家賃は２．８％だった。

・航空運賃は１９．４％上昇。旅行代金のインフレ率は８月から縮小した。

・構成品目変動率の中央値を示す「ＣＰＩメジアン」は９月に１．９％、極端な価格変動の項目を除外した「ＣＰＩトリム」は１．８％だった。

items.title: Texans WR Tank Dell (knee) set to return after 22-month recovery
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Texans receiver Tank Dell will take the field for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday.
items.body:
Texans receiver Tank Dell will take the field for the first time in 22 months when Houston hosts the New York Giants on Sunday.
Dell sustained a serious knee injury in Week 16 of the 2024 season against the Kansas City Chiefs and missed all of last season. Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Dell is ready to return to action.
"No huge expectations from what he needs to do," Ryans said of Dell. "We're all just going to be excited. I know me personally, I'm just going to be excited to see him just out there for the first time in (nearly) two years, just getting some game action. I'm just thankful, grateful for him to have this opportunity to return. I don't have any expectations. I'm just happy to see him out there and that's the only thing that matters."
Dell was injured while making a 30-yard touchdown catch in the third quarter against the Chiefs on Dec. 21, 2024. He dislocated his kneecap, tore three ligaments (ACL, MCL, LCL) and tore the meniscus.
Dell, who turns 27 on Oct. 29, started this season on injured reserve. The Texans opened his 21-day practice window on Oct. 6 and Dell began practicing the following day.
Ryans said that Dell's explosiveness remains impressive.
"He's still quick as ever," Ryans said. "Ask our defenders who was covering him the past couple weeks, he's been putting us in some tough matchups and practice the past two weeks. I expect him to go out on Sunday and do the same thing. Really stress defenders and that's what Tank is going to do with his speed, his playmaking ability."
Dell made 98 catches for 1,376 yards and 10 touchdowns in 25 games (18 starts) over his first two NFL seasons. He was a third-round pick in 2023 out of Houston.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Rams WR Davante Adams (hamstring) out 6-10 weeks
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Los Angeles Rams will be without three-time, first-team All-Pro wide receiver Davante Adams for six to 10 weeks due to a hamstring injury, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday.
items.body:
The Los Angeles Rams will be without three-time, first-team All-Pro wide receiver Davante Adams for six to 10 weeks due to a hamstring injury, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday.
Adams, 33, appeared to sustain the injury -- which McVay described as a ruptured semitendinosus -- while running a route into the end zone late in Sunday's 18-16 home loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
A six-time Pro Bowl selection, Adams has 30 receptions for 480 yards and four touchdowns in six games this season. Over 13 seasons with the Green Bay Packers (2014-21), Las Vegas Raiders (2022-24), New York Jets (2024) and Rams, the Packers' 2014 third-round draft pick has 1,047 catches for 13,113 yards and 121 touchdowns.
Adams wasn't the only player to go down Sunday. Nose tackle Poona Ford suffered a season-ending ruptured triceps, according to McVay, while defensive tackle Kobie Turner is expected to miss four to six weeks with a groin injury and likely will be placed on injured reserve.
Kicker Blake Grupe was placed on injured reserve Monday after tearing his ACL on Sunday. McVay said the Rams are "working on some different options" following Grupe's injury.
Grupe was added to the roster last week when the Rams released Harrison Mevis.
As for pass rusher Myles Garrett, McVay said he will not return to practice this week. Following mid-September knee surgery, the five-time first-team All-Pro has missed the last five games.
Cornerback Trent McDuffie, who missed Sunday's game after suffering a groin injury at practice last week, is "progressing," according to McVay.
"He's feeling much better," McVay said. "The hope is progress this week and kind of determine his status at the end of this week."
With Adams out, the Rams will discuss adding a receiver. Along with first-team All-Pro Puka Nacua, Los Angeles' active roster includes receivers Konata Mumpfield, Jordan Whittington, Tutu Atwell, C.J. Daniels and Alex Bachman. Mumpfield leads that group with eight receptions for 127 yards and one touchdown.
--Field Level Media

Banamex anunció el lunes la colocación de 900 millones de dólares en instrumentos de capital híbrido conocidos como Additional Tier 1 (AT1), una operación con la que busca fortalecer su estructura de capital. Los títulos perpetuos pagan una tasa anual de 9.50% y podrán ser amortizados anticipadamente por el banco a partir de 5.5 años después de su emisión, según un comunicado de la empresa.
La institución dijo que la oferta registró una sobredemanda de inversionistas de Estados Unidos, Europa, Asia y América Latina. La operación ocurre mientras Banamex busca consolidarse como entidad independiente tras separarse de Citigroup luego de que el grupo estadounidense canceló la venta del negocio y optó por escindir y listar la unidad mexicana.

items.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu in unannounced visit to Israel, reports Axios
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge.
items.body:
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during an unannounced visit to Israel on Monday, Axios reported, citing two sources with knowledge.
Reuters could not immediately confirm the visit. The Pentagon declined comment, while Israel's embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
News of Hegseth's trip comes a day after US President Donald Trump [USN:L1N46403J TEXT:"endorsed"] Netanyahu in next week's parliamentary election in Israel - its first vote since the Hamas attack on October 7, 2023, that shook the country and plunged the Middle East into turmoil, as Israel went to war in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition is projected to lose its governing majority, although the opposition may also struggle to form a government, opinion polls show.
US Vice President JD Vance, however, declined to endorse Netanyahu in an interview earlier on Monday, saying he was not getting involved in Israeli elections.
"I endorse American candidates, and that's where I'm focused on is the midterms," Vance, who traveled to Budapest and [USN:L1N40Q06M TEXT:"endorsed"] Viktor Orban in Hungarian election earlier this year, said in an interview with digital media outlet 2WAY.
"I'm not anti-endorsing him, but I'm not pro-endorsing him, I'm not getting involved in Israeli elections." Vance said.

items.summary: A Rio de Janeiro court on Monday approved Brazilian retailer Americanas' AMER3.SA formal conclusion of bankruptcy proceedings, the company said in a securities filing.
items.body:
A Rio de Janeiro court on Monday approved Brazilian retailer Americanas' <AMER3.SA> formal conclusion of bankruptcy proceedings, the company said in a securities filing.
Americanas unveiled accounting inconsistencies in early 2023 worth multi-billion dollars that led it to file for bankruptcy protection in Brazil.
The company claimed it had been impacted by fraudulent activities from its former management.
A Rio de Janeiro court has turned 12 former executives of Americanas into defendants as part of the case.
In the filing, Americanas said it is committed to growing its operations, sustainably strengthening its business model, and enhancing customer experience.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - データセンター事業者の英新興エヌスケールが、対話型人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発する米アンソロピック向けにＡＩ計算能力を提供する新たな契約について協議している。事情に詳しい関係者が１９日ロイターに明かした。契約額は約４５０億ドルに上る可能性がある。

関係者の話では、エヌスケールは米南部ウェストバージニア州の「モナーク」データセンター・キャンパス内の第２棟について、アンソロピックとの大型契約締結を目指している。

アンソロピックは既に８月、同州のモナーク・キャンパスの第１棟でエヌスケールが提供するＡＩクラウドコンピューティング能力を借り受けるため、４５０億ドルを支払う契約を結んだ。第２棟では、エヌビディアの先進ＡＩチップ「ベラ・ルービン」を使用し、４６０メガワットの計算能力を提供する計画という。

アンソロピックはロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

関係者は、アンソロピックはモナーク第３棟についても優先交渉権を保有していると述べた。ただ協議は継続中で、計画の詳細は変更される可能性がある。

今回の提携協議は、マイクロソフトがエヌスケールの主力データセンター案件から撤退した後に浮上した。撤退の背景には、電力接続の遅れにより、電力供給開始時期が２０３０年代にずれ込む見通しとなったことがあった。

エヌスケールは創業以来急成長を続けており、２年半で契約総額を１億ドルから１０３０億ドル超へ拡大した。コアウィーブ、ネビウス、クルーソー、ラムダなどが競合相手だ。エヌスケールの目論見書によると、将来的にはマイクロソフトとアンソロピックが同社の主要顧客となる見通しとなっている。

items.title: Belarus bars entry to some goods from Latvia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Belarus, one of Russia's closest allies, said on Monday it was barring the entry of a number of goods from neighbouring Latvia because of the Baltic state's "unfriendly" relations.
items.body:
Belarus, one of Russia's closest allies, said on Monday it was barring the entry of a number of goods from neighbouring Latvia because of the Baltic state's "unfriendly" relations.
Belarus's government had slapped the ban on a range of products including canned fish and various industrial goods, state news agency Belta said.
"This decision was taken in connection with the Latvian side maintaining an unconstructive approach and unfriendly rhetoric in relation to Belarus," Belta quoted the government decision as saying.
Latvia [USN:L6N43X1AH TEXT:"closed"] its border with Belarus in July.
Like Belarus's other neighbours, Latvia has encountered difficulties with Minsk over mass attempts by migrants to cross the Belarusian border into the European Union.
Belarus denies colluding or encouraging migrants from other countries to attempt to cross its borders into the EU.
Led by President Alexander Lukashenko since 1994, Belarus has long been accused of human rights abuses subject to Western sanctions. Lukashenko allowed Russia to use Belarusian territory to help launch the 2022 invasion of Ukraine but has declined to commit his country's forces to the conflict.

items.title: Brewers’ sweep of Dodgers draws best NLCS audience since 2015
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers needed just four games to sweep the Los Angeles Dodgers, but the National League Championship Series still delivered its largest television audience in 11 years.
items.body:
The Milwaukee Brewers needed just four games to sweep the Los Angeles Dodgers, but the National League Championship Series still delivered its largest television audience in 11 years.
Milwaukee's sweep averaged 7.533 million viewers across Fox, FS1 and Fox Deportes, according to Fox Sports. It was the largest average audience for a League Championship Series on any network since 2015.
The figure was up 77% compared with the first four games of the 2025 American League Championship Series on Fox and FS1, which averaged 4.261 million viewers. The Toronto Blue Jays and Seattle Mariners played in that series.
The strong numbers continued through Milwaukee's pennant-clinching 6-4 victory Thursday at Dodger Stadium.
Game 4 drew 6.364 million viewers across FS1 and Fox Deportes. The FS1 telecast alone averaged 6.135 million viewers, making it the most-watched Game 4 of an LCS on any network since 2018.
That was up 107% from the 2.964 million viewers who watched Game 4 of last year's ALCS on FS1.
Thursday's audience peaked at 7.322 million on FS1 between 11 and 11:08 p.m. ET.
Milwaukee denied the two-time defending World Series champion Dodgers a chance at a third straight title.
The Brewers instead advanced to the World Series for the first time since 1982. Milwaukee, which won an MLB-best 103 regular-season games, will seek its first World Series championship in franchise history.
The 2026 NLCS reversed the result from a year earlier, when Los Angeles swept Milwaukee in four games on its way to a second straight title.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Juan Martin del Potro tops list of '27 Hall of Fame candidates
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Juan Martin del Potro, the 2009 U.S. Open men's singles champion, heads the list of player nominees for the 2027 International Tennis Hall of Fame class.
items.body:
Juan Martin del Potro, the 2009 U.S. Open men's singles champion, heads the list of player nominees for the 2027 International Tennis Hall of Fame class.
del Potro, of Argentina, was joined on the ballot by former WTA stars Ash Barty of Australia and Svetlana Kuznetsova of Russia, the Hall announced Monday.
del Potro won 22 times on the ATP Tour, with his most notable triumph coming 17 years ago in Flushing Meadows. He took down Rafael Nadal in the semifinals and then Roger Federer in the final for his lone Grand Slam title. Against Federer, del Potro rallied from two sets to one down to dethrone the five-time defending champion.
The Argentine experienced international glory in 2016 when he led his country to its first Davis Cup championship. He also earned a silver medal in singles at the Rio Olympics that year.
Barty won three majors and stood atop the WTA rankings for 121 weeks in her career. She won the French Open women's singles title in 2019, the Wimbledon singles title in 2021 and the Australian Open women's title in 2022. Her international resume included a bronze medal in mixed doubles at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
Kuznetsova won two majors each in singles (2004 U.S. Open, 2009 French Open) and doubles (2005 and 2012 Australian Open). She won 18 singles titles and 16 doubles titles on tour. She was ranked as high as No. 2 in singles and No. 3 in doubles.
Fans can vote on the nominees through Oct. 25. The results will be applied as bonus points to the voting percentages produced by the Hall's Official Voting Group, a panel composed of tennis journalists, historians and Hall of Famers. A candidate must receive at least 75 percent of the combined vote from the fans and Official Voting Group for induction.
--Field Level Media

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US State Department has asked Americans to reconsider any travel to Kenya, citing what it called the risk of health, crime, unrest and extremism.
items.body:
The US State Department has asked Americans to reconsider any travel to Kenya, citing what it called the risk of health, crime, unrest and extremism.
"Reconsider travel to Kenya due to risk of health, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic safety. Some areas have increased risk," the State Department said on Monday, raising the advisory to level 3 that asks Americans to reconsider travel, from an earlier level 2 that urges increased caution.

Shares of 3M were up more than 5 per cent in extended trading after the announcement.

items.title: Former Google CEO Schmidt owns 1% stake in Anthropic, Bloomberg reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt owns about 1% of Anthropic, positioning him for one of the largest individual windfalls when the AI startup goes public, Bloomberg News reported on Monday.
items.body:
Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt owns about 1% of Anthropic, positioning him for one of the largest individual windfalls when the AI startup goes public, Bloomberg News reported on Monday.
Schmidt invested tens of millions of dollars in Anthropic's Series A funding round, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. It was unclear whether he has sold any of his stake since.
Schmidt's representatives declined to comment. Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.
Anthropic's planned initial public offering is expected to generate substantial returns for its early investors and employees.
Some investors discussed a valuation of around [USN:L6N4611F6 TEXT:"$1.5 trillion"] at an investor meeting, below earlier expectations of roughly $2 trillion, Reuters reported last week.
In its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters in September, Anthropic laid out a vision that AI will transform the global economy more profoundly than industrialization, electricity and the internet.
Amazon and Google were among Anthropic's early backers, investing billions of dollars and supplying the cloud computing capacity required to develop and run its Claude AI models.
Schmidt served as Google's CEO from 2001 to 2011 and later as executive chairman of its parent company, Alphabet, before stepping down in January 2018.

Oct 19 : Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt owns about 1 per cent of Anthropic, positioning him for one of the largest individual windfalls when the AI startup goes public, Bloomberg News reported on Monday.
• Schmidt invested tens of millions of dollars in Anthropic's Series A funding round, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. It was unclear whether he has sold any of his stake since.
• Schmidt's representatives declined to comment. Anthropic did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.
• Anthropic's planned initial public offering is expected to generate substantial returns for its early investors and employees.

• Amazon and Google were among Anthropic's early backers, investing billions of dollars and supplying the cloud computing capacity required to develop and run its Claude AI models.
• Schmidt served as Google's CEO from 2001 to 2011 and later as executive chairman of its parent company, Alphabet, before stepping down in January 2018.

items.title: Australia's Albanese says attacker's car made U-turn before critically injuring lawmaker
items.author: Renju Jose
items.creator: Renju Jose
items.summary: The car that struck an independent Australian lawmaker outside her office had performed a U-turn before hitting her, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Tuesday, describing the incident as clearly intentional.
items.body:
The car that struck an independent Australian lawmaker outside her office had performed a U-turn before hitting her, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Tuesday, describing the [USN:L1N46508R TEXT:"incident"] as clearly intentional.
[USN:L4N4650NF TEXT:"Helen Haines"] underwent surgery overnight and remained in critical condition after she was struck by a white Toyota Land Cruiser in Wangaratta, around three hours' drive northeast of Melbourne, on Monday.
"It's clear that there was a deliberate act here. This wasn't an accident, someone just skidding off the road," Albanese told ABC News.
Early investigations suggested the car hit Haines as she was loading or unloading things from the trunk of her car, he said.
A 43-year-old man was arrested following the attack, with counter-terrorism authorities among the multiple agencies involved in the investigation. Police indicated the man was expected to be interviewed on Tuesday morning and stressed they were treating the incident as isolated.
Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke told ABC Radio that witnesses said the alleged attacker reversed the vehicle and struck Haines a second time before a bystander intervened.
Ricky Jefferies ran from his barber shop and restrained the attacker and removed a knife from him after initially believing the incident was a car accident, Australian media reported.
"I heard a loud bang with no brakes. It was crazy, I just ran out to the front to see what's happening," Jefferies told reporters outside his shop.
"I didn't realise the seriousness of the situation initially, and once it became relevant I just did what I could and what others were already trying to do."
'TURN TEMPERATURE DOWN' Violent attacks on politicians are extremely rare in Australia, where federal lawmakers, state leaders and even prime ministers are regularly seen in supermarkets and coffee shops, attending community events and chatting with voters with minimal security.
[USN:L4N4650NF TEXT:"Haines"] worked in nursing and midwifery and as an academic before being elected to parliament as an independent in 2019 in the seat of Indi. She retained the seat in 2022 and 2025.
While Albanese said it was too early to determine a motive, he urged Australians to engage more respectfully with one another, expressing concern about growing division in the country. He also noted a "significant increase" in threats against politicians in recent years.
Politicians worldwide are facing rising levels of violence, threats and harassment, with 71% of respondents to a February survey by the Inter-Parliamentary Union reporting experiencing violence from the public, particularly online.
Incidents of threatening or harassing behaviour towards lawmakers in Australia had risen to 1,067 in the past year, from 951 the previous year.
"We all have a responsibility to turn the temperature down," Albanese said.
"I really don't want to see the character of Australia change," he said. "But this is a challenge for us as a nation to make sure that we retain that sense of identity, that sense of belonging, that sense of unity as a country that is so important for us."

items.title: 米国の判断「説明困難」、支援巡りゼレンスキー氏が疑問
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１９日、兵器供給の遅延や情報共有の制限など、ウクライナでの戦争を巡る米国の判断は「説明し難い」と述べた。

米議会代表団との会談で「結局のところ、全てはロシアのプーチン大統領がこの戦争の終結を拒んでいることと、友人同士では説明し難い米国側の判断に行き着く」と語った。

ゼレンスキー氏は、一部のドローン（無人機）攻撃の実施や、特に高速のジェット推進式ドローンによるロシアの攻撃への防御に必要な衛星通信システム「スターシールド」の利用制限について、十分な説明を受けていないと述べた。

通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿された動画の中で、過去１週間に３回、通常は支援国から提供される攻撃の事前警告を受けられなかったと明らかにした。

「残念ながら、支援国がＰＵＲＬ（ウクライナ優先支援要件リスト）の枠組みを通じて既に代金を支払ったミサイルについて、米国防総省が引き渡しを遅らせていることも把握している」と述べた。

自身が把握する限り、ミサイル供与の１案件がヘグセス米国防長官の署名待ちになっていると説明。

「こうしたことは全て、われわれへの支援を遅らせる何らかの政治的判断が下されたことを示唆している」と語った。

また、米政府が地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」の迎撃ミサイルを供給するなら、トランプ米大統領の要求に応じ、ロシアの製油所への攻撃を３０日間停止する用意があると述べた。

さらに、ウクライナ代表団が数日中にノルウェーで、米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使、およびトランプ氏の娘婿ジャレッド・クシュナー氏と会談することに期待を示した。

items.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily Podcast: Tech Earnings Kick Off
items.summary:
A rebound in chipmakers buoyed the stock market Monday as dip buyers emerged on bets the artificial-intelligence investment boom will continue to support solid earnings. The advance in tech stocks lost steam last week as investors questioned the sustainability of AI spending, given the outlook for higher rates. This week’s earnings from Meta Platforms will provide a fresh proving ground for confidence in the AI trade, while SpaceX, Tesla, and Meta are also due to report. The industry is still set to account for nearly 70% of global earnings growth next year, according to Citigroup.

On today's episode:

Mandeep Singh, Bloomberg Intelligence Global Head of Technology
Dan Ives, Partner at Yorkville Ives & Co.
Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas & Ed Ludlow, Host of Bloomberg Tech
Sophie Alexander, Bloomberg New Wealth Reporter & Alex Rajbhandari, Bloomberg News US Insurance Reporter (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 盗聴容疑の元オープンＡＩ従業員、サウジ政府が支援か　米検察主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Goudsward　Aditya Soni

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Goudsward　Aditya Soni

[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米連邦検察は、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩの幹部用会議室に録音装置を設置したとして起訴した元従業員のアブドルラフマン・アルフォザン被告（３５）が、サウジアラビア政府から相当な支援を受けていたと、裁判所に提出した書面で明らかにした。

公開された書面によると、検察はアルフォザン被告がサウジ王室の一員と頻繁に連絡を取っていたほか、逮捕後にはサウジ軍関係者が被告の妻と幼い息子のサウジ帰国用片道航空券を手配したと主張している。

検察は被告に逃亡の恐れがあるとして、公判まで身柄拘束を継続するよう連邦地裁に要請した。アルフォザン被告はサウジ国籍で米国永住権を持つ。

また検察は拘束請求書面で「被告は特別に設計された暗号化録音装置を用い、オープンＡＩの上級幹部や経営陣、重要な取引先、政府関係者らが出席する極めて機密性の高い会議を秘密裏に録音するため、多大な労力を費やした」と指摘した。

サウジ政府当局はコメント要請に回答せず、アルフォザン被告の弁護士も現時点でコメントしていない。

一方、弁護側のウィリアム・パーニク弁護士は、ＧＰＳによる行動監視や旅券返納などを条件に保釈を求めており、被告は過去１５年間を米国で過ごし、市民権取得も申請済みだと述べている。今月予定されていたサウジ渡航については捜査対象となる前から手配されており、「家族および移民手続き上の理由」によるものだったと説明した。

米検察は先週、アルフォザン被告を通信傍受罪で起訴した。刑事告発状によると、被告はサンフランシスコにあるオープンＡＩ社屋内の幹部用会議室で、テレビの背面に録音装置を接続した。装置が設置されていた時期には政府関係者が出席する会議も同会議室で開かれていたとされる。

さらに検察は捜査が継続中であり、追加起訴の可能性もあるとしている。

提出書面によれば、サウジ王室の一員は被告に対し、サウジ国内のＡＩ関連職への就任を打診するとともに「サウジは米国以上にあなたを必要としている」とメッセージを送信。被告は「１００（１００％同意する）」と返信したとされる。

逮捕前にアルフォザン被告は育児休暇の一環としてサウジ首都リヤドへ渡航し、約２カ月間滞在する予定だった。検察によると、被告の妻は捜査当局に対し、自身と息子はサウジへ恒久的に移住する計画で、被告も最終的には合流する意向だったと説明した。

被告は先月、アラビア語のポッドキャスト番組に出演し、年に３－４回サウジを訪問しているほか、現地のスタートアップ企業へ助言やメンタリングを行っていると語っていた。２０１６年にシリコンバレーで当時副皇太子だったムハンマド皇太子と面会したことをきっかけに、一流テクノロジー企業で経験を積み、その知識と技術を祖国へ持ち帰りたいと考えるようになったとも話している。

items.title: EUA e Cuba trocam farpas na ONU antes da votação sobre sanções
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski
items.summary: Os Estados Unidos e Cuba trocaram acusações na Organização das Nações Unidas nesta segunda-feira, depois que diplomatas norte-americanos organizaram um evento com a participação de dissidentes cubanos, antes da votação anual da ONU, na próxima semana, sobre uma resolução que pede o fim do embargo dos EUA à ilha.
items.body:
Os Estados Unidos e Cuba trocaram acusações na Organização das Nações Unidas nesta segunda-feira, depois que diplomatas norte-americanos organizaram um evento com a participação de dissidentes cubanos, antes da votação anual da ONU, na próxima semana, sobre uma resolução que pede o fim do embargo dos EUA à ilha.
O embaixador cubano na ONU, Ernesto Soberón Guzmán, e outros representantes gritaram com o embaixador dos EUA na ONU, Mike Waltz, quando ele saía do evento no prédio da ONU, que teve como foco alegações de violações dos direitos humanos por parte do governo cubano.
As tensões entre as duas nações estão aumentando antes da votação da resolução não vinculativa, que vem sendo aprovada na Assembleia Geral da ONU por ampla maioria todos os anos desde 1992, e em meio à crescente pressão causada pelo bloqueio petrolífero imposto pelos EUA a Cuba.
“Espero que vocês... tenham notado os chamados diplomatas da embaixada cubana aqui, que permitimos a presença por força de um tratado, assediando, gritando, intimidando e filmando não apenas nossos ex-presos políticos recém-libertados, mas também outras pessoas”, disse Waltz a repórteres em Nova York.
“Ano após ano, o regime cubano vem à Assembleia Geral e propaga uma mentira por meio de sua resolução anual... Ele usa uma desculpa atrás da outra para justificar sua opressão, para justificar o sofrimento do povo cubano, e o que estamos fazendo aqui na missão dos EUA na ONU é expor essas mentiras”, afirmou ele.
A votação está prevista para os dias 27 e 28 de outubro, informaram autoridades.
Os EUA mantêm um embargo comercial contra Cuba há mais de 60 anos, e o governo do presidente norte-americano Donald Trump vem intensificando a pressão, após ter recorrido aos militares em janeiro para destituir o presidente venezuelano Nicolás Maduro.
A votação na ONU pode ter peso político, mas somente o Congresso dos EUA pode suspender o embargo da era da Guerra Fria.
Cuba atribuiu às sanções dos EUA a crise em que o país se encontra atolado — a pior recessão econômica em décadas, caracterizada pela escassez de bens básicos, infraestrutura em colapso e inflação galopante.
“Os EUA estão agindo como um delinquente internacional, impondo punição coletiva ao povo de Cuba. Estão infligindo imenso sofrimento a toda a população de uma nação pacífica”, disse Guzmán, o embaixador cubano, em uma reunião improvisada do lado de fora do encontro dos EUA com dissidentes.
No mês passado, Trump afirmou na ONU que Cuba era um Estado falido e que a liberdade chegaria à nação insular.
A rede elétrica de Cuba sofreu um colapso total no mês passado, mergulhando o país na escuridão e deixando milhões sem energia elétrica.

items.title: Texas federal judge suspended from hearing cases over mental health concerns
items.author: Nate Raymond
items.creator: Nate Raymond
items.summary: A federal judge in Texas has been temporarily suspended from hearing cases after a judicial investigation determined she likely suffers from a mental condition interfering with her ability to perform the responsibilities of her office.
items.body:
A federal judge in Texas has been temporarily suspended from hearing cases after a judicial investigation determined she likely suffers from a mental condition interfering with her ability to perform the responsibilities of her office.
The 5th Circuit Judicial Council in an order that was made public on Monday said a judicial inquiry found that US District Judge Ada Brown in Dallas had "abandoned her post as a federal judge" while stepping aside from numerous cases and inundating court staff and judges with "bizarre emails" and "racial insults."
Judicial misconduct investigations are typically conducted confidentially. But the judicial council on Monday voted to make much of it public after Brown on Saturday "widely disseminated confidential materials related to these proceedings."
Bloomberg Law on Saturday published a report citing internal 5th Circuit records regarding the investigation into Brown, who was appointed to the US District Court for the Northern District of Texas by President Donald Trump during his first term.
A day earlier, a three-judge investigative committee had ordered Brown to sit for an interview on October 30 to address a judicial misconduct complaint that was initiated against her by Chief US Circuit Judge Jennifer Walker Elrod.
Brown could not be reached for comment by Reuters on Monday.
The judicial misconduct proceedings began after someone filed a complaint alleging Brown had made inappropriate and hostile comments toward that person and may be suffering from a mental condition interfering with her duties.
Elrod in August appointed a special committee that included herself to investigate the matter. The committee determined there was a reasonable basis to conclude she was suffering from such a mental health issue.
The committee pointed to instances in which Brown made "aberrant and inappropriate comments" during a hearing; requested the Texas Rangers investigate unsubstantiated claims that others were entering orders in her cases; and made "racial insults to judges and court staff."
Brown, who is Black and has Native American ancestry, also made claims that judges, attorneys and court staff "are discriminating and retaliating against her because of her race and/or gender," according to a 5th Circuit order.
The investigation also found she had recused herself from 40 cases since June for unexplained or unusual reasons, such as by citing concerns about the "constitutionality and ethics of these matters."
The inquiry found that a significant backlog of outstanding matters had developed on her docket, with the judge for years habitually delaying rulings on motions, which the order described as a "dereliction" of her duties.
Based on those allegations, the committee on September 21 ordered Brown to sit for a psychiatric exam, and the judicial council on September 29 ordered her cases to be reassigned temporarily and that no further cases be assigned to her.
Documents released by the 5th Circuit said Brown in response to the inquiry had failed to respond to numerous questions. At one point she said she planned to resign, though she has not done so even while refusing to return to work, according to the 5th Circuit documents.

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（19日）ユーロ下落、ナスダック1％超高　利回り上昇
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ＜為替＞
items.body:
＜為替＞ ユーロが対ドルで下落した。フランスでの暴動が同国の財政見通し悪化への懸念を一段と強めた。一方、ドルは人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の反発を受けて上昇した。

フランスでは、政府が財政赤字の縮小を図る中、政府に対する全国的な抗議デモが週末に暴動と略奪に発展。これを受け、フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。

今回の暴動は、極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が来年の大統領選で勝利する可能性を高めるとも見られており、フランスのＥＵ残留を巡って疑問が浮上する恐れがある。

ユーロは０．２４％安の１．１２１２ドル。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐに拡大し、２０１１─１２年の欧州債務危機以来の水準で取引された。

ドルは、ＡＩ関連株が先週の急落から反発したことを受けて上昇した。先週は、ＡＩ株に対する熱狂の後退が資本流入を細らせ、ドル需要を減退させるとの懸念からドルが押し下げられていた。

円は対ドルで０．３５％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．４９円。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが上昇した。ＡＩ（人工知能）関連株に高金利が及ぼす影響に対する懸念が和らいだことを背景に、安全資産への資金流入の動きが一服した。

先週はＡＩ関連インフラ銘柄への投資が鈍化する可能性があるとの懸念から株式市場で大幅な売りが出たことで、安全資産とされる米国債への需要が高まり、指標１０年債利回りは先週、１４．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下。ただ、この日は株式市場でＡＩ関連株が持ち直し、ハイテク関連銘柄が多いナスダック総合指数は１％超上昇した。

終盤の取引で、１０年債利回りは４．２ｂｐ上昇の５．１４％。３０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の５．４７７％。

２年債利回りは２．５ｂｐ上昇の４．７６１％。２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３７．５ｂｐ。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ハイテク株の比重が高いナスダック総合が１％超上昇した。先週大幅下落した半導体やその他の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株に買いが戻った。投資家は主要企業の決算発表を待っている。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）大手メタ・プラットフォームズは０．５％安で終了した。同社は電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラとともに２１日に決算を発表する予定。スペースＸは２０日に発表する。

ダウ工業株３０種は小幅に下落、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は小幅に上昇した。

ただ、相場の上昇は指数への影響が大きい大型株に強く依存した。また、主要指数は取引時間中にこの日の高値から水準を切り下げた。原油価格の変動に伴い、エネルギー市場からの支援材料が一部失われたことが一因だった。

クラウドコンピューティング企業コアウィーブは、５００億ドルの債務負担への懸念から先週２５％超急落し、売りの中心となっていた。この日はゴールドマン・サックスによる投資判断の「ニュートラル」から「バイ」への引き上げに反応したとみられる序盤の上昇を維持できず、０．４％安で取引を終えた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の政策決定を控え、ドル高と米長期金利の上昇が重しとなり、金相場は下落した。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比０．５％安の１オンス＝４１６０．１０ドル。現物価格も０．４％安の４１４７．８７ドルとなった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ イランが支援するイエメンの親イラン武装組織「フーシ」によるイエメン軍訓練キャンプへの攻撃や、サウジアラビアのエネルギー、空港、軍事施設への攻撃再開を受け、まちまちの展開となった。米ＷＴＩ先物の清算値は、前日比２．２５ドル（２．２％）高の１バレル＝１０３．６６ドルと、９月１５日以来の高値を付けた。一方、北海ブレント先物は０．３１ドル（０．３％）安の１０９．５５ドルで清算。前週に５カ月ぶり高値まで上昇した反動から利益確定売りが先行し、取引序盤には３ドル超下落する場面もあった。

ＷＴＩは１０月２０日の期近限月の期限切れを前に、商いが低調だった。取引は流動性の高い１２月物に集中し、売買高は１９万５０００枚超に達した。期限切れを控えた１１月物の売買高は約２万６０００枚にとどまった。１２月物の清算値は０．５％安の９８．５４ドルだった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.title: Alger’s Crawford: There’s Skittishness in the Market
items.summary: Ankur Crawford, a Portfolio Manager at Alger and Former Intel Engineer, said recent market nervousness around AI— including concerns tied to CoreWeave—does not reflect the strength of underlying adoption and infrastructure demand. She described a striking gap between stock performance and on-the-ground fundamentals, while noting that returns from AI investment will take time and that debt, supply-chain bottlenecks, labor shortages and power constraints could slow the buildout. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: UniCredit to buy back securities-services unit from Societe Generale, document shows
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy's second-biggest bank, UniCredit , has signed an agreement to repurchase its securities-services business from French peer Societe Generale , according to a union document seen by Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
Italy's second-biggest bank, UniCredit (CRDI.MI) , has signed an agreement to repurchase its securities-services business from French peer Societe Generale (SOGN.PA) , according to a union document seen by Reuters on Monday.
The unit, which looks after investors' securities and handles related administrative services, has 54 staff in Milan and Turin, according to the document, which did not provide any financial details of the agreement.
Societe Generale bought UniCredit's securities services unit in 2006, striking a long-term partnership to handle those services for the Italian bank. The supply contract was last renewed in 2017 until 2026.
UniCredit is seeking to bring in-house activities it deems strategic, and the transaction is part of that effort, the document said.
Handling the securities itself will reduce the need for an external supplier and improve use of the business' data,
UniCredit and Societe Generale did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

items.title: Reports: Hornets F Brandon Miller agrees to five-year, $209M extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Charlotte Hornets forward Brandon Miller agreed to a five-year, $209 million extension, according to multiple reports on Monday.
items.body:
Charlotte Hornets forward Brandon Miller agreed to a five-year, $209 million extension, according to multiple reports on Monday.
Miller became the main building piece for the Hornets when the club traded guard LaMelo Ball to the Minnesota Timberwolves in the offseason.
Entering his fourth season, Miller underwent offseason surgery on his left shoulder but is ready for the campaign. The Hornets open the season Wednesday by visiting the Brooklyn Nets.
Miller, who turns 24 on Nov. 22, was the second overall pick of the 2023 draft out of Alabama. He has career averages of 19.0 points, 4.6 rebounds and 3.0 assists and has made 492 3-pointers in 166 career games (160 starts).
Miller averaged 20.2 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.3 assists and sank a career-high 204 treys in 65 games last season.
In 2024-25, Miller was limited to 27 games due to a right wrist injury.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Tottenham's agonising wait for a Premier League win ends with Coventry victory
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Tottenham Hotspur fans have been crying out for a bit of quality this season and they finally got it on Monday as the North London side claimed their first Premier League win in 148 days with a 3-1 home success against Coventry City.
items.body:
Tottenham Hotspur fans have been crying out for a bit of quality this season and they finally got it on Monday as the North London side claimed their first Premier League win in 148 days with a 3-1 home success against Coventry City.
Tottenham are the last of the 92 clubs in England's football league to earn a victory this season and move off the bottom of the Premier League standings and into 16th with six points from seven games, one place ahead of Coventry.
"We are very happy for the result and we played much better than in other games. It was important to get this win," Tottenham manager Roberto De Zerbi said.
James Maddison started for the first time since May 2025 and marked the occasion with a superb opening goal that had the home faithful off their seats.
But there was even better to come as Omar Marmoush netted his first for the club since his move from Manchester City with a rasping drive from 25 yards, before Ben Davies added a late third.
"We knew we wanted to win and today was the day, so hopefully we can kick on from here," defender Jan Paul van Hecke said. "We needed to be patient. It was not an easy game for us with Coventry's low (defensive) block."
Perhaps the biggest cheer of the night came when winger Dejan Kulusevski was introduced off the bench on his return from a lengthy injury spell that was ended with his first competitive action in 526 days.
A first win of the season, the return of key players and a little more swagger in the side made this a potential turning point in the season for Tottenham, who had only scored three goals in the campaign before Monday's win.
Having spent upwards of 308 million pounds ($409.70 million) in the last transfer window as part of a major rebuilding project under manager De Zerbi, there were finally signs of improvement for the side following last season's brush with relegation.
The question is now whether they can find consistency. Next up for Tottenham is an away trip to Chelsea on Saturday.
"It is another big game and we need to go there with personality and believe we can win, and we can because we have the quality," Van Hecke said.
($1 = 0.7518 pounds)

items.title: Giants undecided at QB, John Harbaugh 'honing in on decision'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Giants head coach John Harbaugh was not ready Monday to name his starting quarterback for Week 7 after J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston in New York's loss to the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
items.body:
Giants head coach John Harbaugh was not ready Monday to name his starting quarterback for Week 7 after J.J. McCarthy replaced Jameis Winston in New York's loss to the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
"We're working through that now, honing in on a decision," Harbaugh told reporters Monday.
The Giants (3-2-1) remain in the NFC East race despite the 34-27 loss, and McCarthy nearly led New York to a comeback in the final 12 minutes.
Winston threw his second interception early in the fourth quarter. McCarthy threw for 243 yards, recovering from an interception on his first drive by throwing a touchdown pass to Isaiah Likely.
Winston completed 14 of 26 passes for 152 yards and a touchdown, but New York committed four turnovers to the Saints' one.
"I mean, Jameis has done a great job in so many ways, and I just admire him and respect him for it," Harbaugh said. "He's helped us win games and did what he had to do to win games and that's something you value very much. And J.J. just got here a couple weeks ago and where do we stand? We're trying to put an offense together that he's got a feel for and those kinds of things. So, all those things are things you factor in."
Houston (2-4) is up next for the Giants this Sunday. The Texans have scored 60 points over the past two weeks while winning consecutive games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: National Australia Bank to cut 2,500 jobs in cost overhaul as credit growth slows
items.author: Scott Murdoch, Rajasik Mukherjee
items.creator: Scott Murdoch, Rajasik Mukherjee
items.summary:
National Australia Bank Ltd
said on Tuesday it will shed up to 2,500 jobs, or about 6% of its workforce, in the next year to simplify its operations and cut costs while the nation's credit growth remains under pressure.
items.body:
National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB.AX)
said on Tuesday it will shed up to 2,500 jobs, or about 6% of its workforce, in the next year to simplify its operations and cut costs while the nation's credit growth remains under pressure.
The bank, which is Australia's biggest business lender and third-largest home lender, said up to 1,500 roles would go by the end of 2026.
The biggest cuts will target corporate roles rather than customer-facing bankers, it said.
It also plans to materially reduce its use of consultants and contractors.
"Our ambition and strategy remain unchanged. We will improve productivity, risk outcomes and execution to be a simpler and more efficient bank," Chief Executive Andrew Irvine said in a statement.
NAB stock was down nearly 2.5% on Tuesday, and recorded the largest share price decline of Australia's "Big Four" retail banks in the session. The S&P/ASX 200 (.AXJO) was down 0.9%.
NAB said it would begin consultation with the Finance Sector Union, whose national assistant secretary Nicole McPherson said the job cuts would not help simplify the organisation.
"To take a wrecking ball to 6% of one of Australia's largest workforces this close to Christmas is disgraceful and shows that NAB's leadership is completely detached from the lived experience of their workers," she said.
The overhaul will result in a restructuring charge of about A$300 million ($209 million) before tax in 2027, related to redundancy, redeployment and organisational redesign costs.
The charge compares with about A$80 million before tax incurred in each of 2025 and 2026, NAB said.
The job cuts follow a period of mounting pressure on Australia's banks as weaker housing activity, rising competition and higher operating costs weigh on earnings.
[USN:L1N44D060 TEXT:"In August"], NAB warned that housing credit growth would slow sharply in 2027 following the [USN:L4N42409E TEXT:"federal government's property tax"] reforms, which the bank said had dampened demand from homebuyers and investors.
At that time, Irvine said the combined effects of geopolitical uncertainty, higher domestic interest rates and tax changes were creating challenges for customers.
NAB employed 41,880 people globally as of September 30, 2025, according to its latest annual report.
The move follows a similar restructuring drive at rival ANZ (ANZ.AX) , which last year announced plans to cut about [USN:L3N3UV1F1 TEXT:"3,500 jobs"] by September 2026 as part of a simplification program under CEO Nuno Matos to reduce duplication and lower costs.
($1 = 1.4329 Australian dollars)

items.title: New Zealand adds Brazil, Canada talks as India pact starts
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Zealand said on Tuesday it will work to deepen trade ties with Brazil and Canada to diversify export markets amid global economic uncertainty, as a free trade agreement with India came into force.
items.body:
New Zealand said on Tuesday it will work to deepen trade ties with Brazil and Canada to diversify export markets amid global economic uncertainty, as a free trade agreement with India came into force.
The announcements come ahead of New Zealand's closely fought November 7 election, with Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay presenting the measures as part of a broader target to double the value of exports by 2034. The first New Zealand-Brazil Trade and Investment Dialogue is expected to be scheduled after Brazil's October 25 election runoff and New Zealand's vote.
From Tuesday more than half of New Zealand's exports to India are tariff-free and this will rise to 82% over time. Tariffs have been removed on products including sheep meat, wool and coal, while apples, kiwifruit and milk albumins will receive preferential quota access. "The gains go well beyond exports. They reach suppliers, local businesses and the towns that depend on them," McClay said.
The statement said New Zealand and Brazil would establish a Trade and Investment Dialogue covering trade, investment, World Trade Organization reform and possible future trade negotiations.
New Zealand and Canada would create an annual dialogue between senior officials, followed by annual trade-minister meetings.

items.title: UK's Healey rules out capital gains tax increase in budget, Times reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British finance minister John Healey has rejected calls to raise capital gains tax in his first budget on October 28, opting instead to prioritise economic growth and business investment, the Times reported on Monday.
items.body:
British finance minister John Healey has rejected calls to raise capital gains tax in his first budget on October 28, opting instead to prioritise economic growth and business investment, the Times reported on Monday.
Healey ruled out the move after being warned that higher capital gains taxes could ultimately reduce government revenues if wealthy individuals left Britain or delayed selling assets, the Times said
Britain's Treasury declined to comment, saying that “decisions on tax are a matter for the Chancellor to set out at fiscal events, rather than routinely commenting on rumour, speculation or proposals.”
The budget's main revenue-raising measure will be a [USN:L8N4610PT TEXT:"levy on banks"], with the proceeds used to fund a targeted, temporary package of cost-of-living support, the report said
Healey is under pressure to raise billions of pounds in tax at his first budget to offset higher borrowing costs and fund Prime Minister Andy Burnham's plans for more defence spending and expanded social care.
The Financial Times [USN:L8N45Z0P5 TEXT:"reported"] last week that Healey had ruled out raising capital gains tax to match income tax rates, though a smaller increase was reported to be under consideration
Capital gains tax, currently [USN:L1N41Y069 TEXT:"charged"] at 18% for basic-rate taxpayers and 24% for higher-rate taxpayers, raised £24 billion ($31.92 billion) in the 2025/26 tax year
($1 = 0.7517 pounds)

items.title: US set to announce certification of Boeing 737 MAX 10 on Tuesday, sources say
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy is expected to announce on Tuesday that the Federal Aviation Administration has approved the Boeing 737 MAX 10 during a visit to Washington State, sources briefed on the plans told Reuters.
items.body:
US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy is expected to announce on Tuesday that the Federal Aviation Administration has approved the Boeing (BA.N) 737 MAX 10 during a visit to Washington State, sources briefed on the plans told Reuters.
Duffy is set to appear on Tuesday at a Boeing factory in Everett, Washington to tout the FAA certification of the long-delayed larger variant of Boeing's best-selling airplane. Boeing in July opened a new line at the Everett plant to expand 737 MAX production, which it also assembles in Renton.
Boeing referred questions to the FAA, which did not immediately comment.
The FAA on Friday conducted a review by the Type Certification Board, which is made up of FAA management team members, in a final step before the agency decides on certification.
Airlines have ordered nearly 1,500 MAX 10s, and the model accounts for about 30% of Boeing's outstanding 737 backlog. The planemaker has already built a handful of MAX 10s awaiting delivery.
The bigger plane that can carry more passengers is crucial to several airlines' growth plans. Major customers for the MAX 10 include United Airlines (UAL.O) , Alaska, Ryanair (RYA.I) , Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) and American Airlines (AAL.O) .
Boeing has faced a more stringent certification process since two fatal MAX 8 crashes in 2018 and 2019, as well as scrutiny of the company's production and quality systems after a January 2024 mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) MAX 9.
Duffy last week met with the chief executives of major aerospace companies including Boeing, RTX, Honeywell, GE Aerospace (GE.N) , Textron, Gulfstream and others in Georgia to discuss how the certification process can be improved.
The FAA in August gave long-awaited approval to the smaller 737 MAX 7 after reviewing the plane for more than eight years. Before the delays, Boeing had initially planned to start delivering the MAX 10 in 2020.
A problem with the anti-ice system on 737 MAX engines that arose in 2023 further delayed certification of the MAX 7 and 10.
A glitch with the latest update of the 737 MAX's navigation software threatened to further delay certification when Boeing disclosed it in late September. However, the FAA determined it did not pose a safety concern and did not require Boeing to fix the problem as a condition of certifying the plane.
Boeing is still working on certifying the 777-9, its largest jetliner in production, which is already six years behind schedule. The company has said it expects to complete certification and begin deliveries in 2027.

items.title: Broncos' Sean Payton: No thought to replacing QB Bo Nix
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton says that he has not considered a quarterback change despite Bo Nix's struggles.
items.body:
Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton says that he has not considered a quarterback change despite Bo Nix's struggles.
Payton parried a question about the QB position during his media availability Monday. The veteran coach said Nix will get better as the entire offense improves.
"He's going to become the byproduct of all the finer things that get improved. The improved play from our offensive line, the more efficient we are relative to balance, running the football. That's our jobs as coaches here," Payton said.
Nix threw for just 107 yards on 17-of-27 passing, with no touchdowns or interceptions, in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win at home over the Seattle Seahawks on Thursday. The third-year pro is averaging 5.6 yards per attempt and completing 60.3% of his passes, both career lows, through six games. He has six touchdown passes to three interceptions.
Denver's defense forced three turnovers, including an overtime interception of Seattle quarterback Sam Darnold, to compensate for an offense that managed just 168 yards Thursday.
"We talked after the game about we're excited to get that win, and yet at the same time find that improvement we need in all areas. So, it starts with all of us," Payton said.
Payton took over play-calling duties from offensive coordinator Davis Webb before Denver's Week 5 victory over the Chargers. On Monday, Payton took some of the blame for Nix not getting the ball downfield against the Seahawks' zone-oriented pass defense.
"I was able to listen to what Bo said specifically and certainly you come away from a game like that and you're wanting a little bit more or obviously a chunk play," Payton said. "That starts with me and us giving him those opportunities when they present itself."
Nix's health has also been a topic of discussion this season. The QB underwent surgery in January to repair an ankle fracture and then had a cleanup procedure in April. Payton addressed a question Monday about whether the injury and recovery have affected Nix mentally.
"The first question, yes, we have a good training room. There's a science behind it. There's a physical, are you healthy or not? All the other things relative to the mental toughness, the mental fortitude," Payton said.
"This is a tough league. We hit every aspect, and I think that's one of the things that attracted us to Bo in the beginning is we had seen his ability to climb through adversity," he added. "It's not just Bo that feels that. Right now, offensively, I feel that, our players feel that and we'll improve."
Despite Nix's production being down, the Broncos are 4-2 and second in the AFC West, 1 1/2 games behind the undefeated Kansas City Chiefs. Denver will face the Arizona Cardinals (2-4) in Glendale, Ariz., on Sunday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: FSU's Mike Norvell: Holding penalty on Hail Mary 'absolute joke'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Two days after Florida State's double-overtime loss to rival Miami on Saturday, Seminoles coach Mike Norvell criticized the officiating, taking issue with a holding penalty that nullified a potential Hail Mary touchdown and the interception that ended the game.
items.body:
Two days after Florida State's double-overtime loss to rival Miami on Saturday, Seminoles coach Mike Norvell criticized the officiating, taking issue with a holding penalty that nullified a potential Hail Mary touchdown and the interception that ended the game.
Norvell also questioned why officials didn't discuss simultaneous possession during the replay review of the final play. On a second Hail Mary attempt, Florida State receiver Duce Robinson and Miami safety Bryce Fitzgerald had their hands on the ball as they fell to the ground in the end zone, but officials ruled it a game-ending interception in the Seminoles' 43-35 double-overtime loss.
"The holding call was an absolute joke," Norvell said of the penalty against offensive lineman Xavier Chaplin that negated a scoring catch by Micahi Danzy. "You go through the course of that game, same thing happened a few plays earlier that was not called. But in that moment, that play -- it's a shame. It really is.
"We had to go convert the two-point play, but for those kids not to be able to finish the game on the field in that moment is really disappointing. That was bad. I haven't gotten the final response from them, but if it's anything less than what I said, it tells me everything I need to know."
Norvell said he discussed both calls with ACC supervisor of officials Gary Patterson.
"You've got two guys going up for a catch and they both come to the ground, simultaneous possession -- that has to be a part of the discussion," Norvell said. "I'm not an official, I'm not sitting there in the command center, but when you broadcast it and that's not mentioned, that's something that at least (should) be part of the discussion I would think."
During the review at the ACC command center in Charlotte, officials focused on whether Fitzgerald controlled the ball but did not discuss simultaneous possession. They upheld the call on the field, ruling that Fitzgerald had possession and full control.
"You can see the defender, he clearly had his hands on the ball when they go to the ground," ESPN football rules analyst Steve Shaw said on the broadcast. "You can see it in his stomach, and so it was an interception. Clearly nothing to overturn it. This was the correct call."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Warriors G Stephen Curry (ankle) sidesteps injury scare
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Golden State Warriors expect to have star guard Stephen Curry on the floor when they open the season against the host Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday night.
items.body:
The Golden State Warriors expect to have star guard Stephen Curry on the floor when they open the season against the host Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday night.
Curry injured his right ankle during Sunday's scrimmage but was a full participant in Monday's morning practice.
He's fine," Golden State coach Steve Kerr said after the practice. "He practiced fully."
One day earlier, Curry was dribbling when he had a misstep and stopped and then banged the basketball on the floor before heading to the bench.
Curry, 38, seemed to respond well to treatment with the latest injury scare.
The Warriors won't have forward Jimmy Butler III and Moses Moody due to knee injuries at the outset of the season while center Kristaps Porzingis is out with a health issue. Guard Brandin Podziemski (back) missed practice Monday and is considered questionable for the opener.
Curry was limited to 43 games last season, with much of the time missed because of a lingering knee injury. Still, Curry averaged 26.6 points, 4.4 made 3-pointers and 11.3 attempted 3-pointers per game -- all above his career averages.
A 12-time All-Star drafted seventh overall out of Davidson in 2009, Curry has two scoring titles, two MVP awards and a Finals MVP award to go with four NBA championships.
Curry has a career scoring average of 24.8 points. He holds the NBA career marks for 3-pointers made (4,248) and attempted (10,073) and for makes (402) in a season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Cowboys LB Dee Winters expected to miss time with Achilles strain
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Dallas Cowboys linebacker Dee Winters is expected to miss time after suffering an Achilles strain during Sunday night's loss to the Green Bay Packers.
items.body:
Dallas Cowboys linebacker Dee Winters is expected to miss time after suffering an Achilles strain during Sunday night's loss to the Green Bay Packers.
Cowboys executive vice president Stephen Jones said Monday on 105.3 The Fan that Winters "will likely miss time" after the injury forced him out during the second quarter of Dallas' 23-13 defeat.
Winters had started each of the Cowboys' first six games and made one of his biggest plays of the season shortly before getting hurt.
He intercepted Green Bay quarterback Jordan Love in the first quarter and returned it for what initially looked like a touchdown. Replay review ruled Winters down by contact, but the interception stood. It was Dallas' first of the season.
Winters entered the game with 35 tackles and a fumble recovery.
His absence could coincide with the return of fellow linebacker DeMarvion Overshown.
Overshown has missed the past five games with a hamstring injury but returned to practice last week and was listed as questionable against Green Bay before ultimately being ruled inactive.
Jones said Monday that Overshown has "a great chance" to play when Dallas visits the Philadelphia Eagles next Monday night.
Overshown is expected to replace Winters at weakside linebacker, with rookie Jaishawn Barham remaining in the middle.
Dallas (2-4) enters the matchup with Philadelphia having lost two straight games.
--Field Level Media

items.title: EEUU y Cuba intercambian ataques en la ONU antes de votación sobre el embargo
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski
items.summary: Estados Unidos y Cuba intercambiaron acusaciones el lunes en las Naciones Unidas, después de que diplomáticos de Washington organizaran un acto en el que participaron disidentes y antes de la votación anual de la próxima semana sobre una resolución que insta a poner fin al embargo sobre la isla.
items.body:
Estados Unidos y Cuba intercambiaron acusaciones el lunes en las Naciones Unidas, después de que diplomáticos de Washington organizaran un acto en el que participaron disidentes y antes de la votación anual de la próxima semana sobre una resolución que insta a poner fin al embargo sobre la isla.
El embajador cubano ante la ONU, Ernesto Soberón Guzmán, y otros representantes le gritaron al embajador estadounidense ante la ONU, Mike Waltz, cuando este abandonaba el acto que se centró en las denuncias de violaciones de los derechos humanos por parte del Gobierno de la isla.
Las tensiones entre ambas naciones van en aumento antes de la votación sobre la resolución no vinculante, que se ha aprobado en la Asamblea General de la ONU por amplia mayoría cada año desde 1992, y en medio de la creciente presión derivada del bloqueo petrolero impuesto por Estados Unidos a Cuba.
"Espero que hayan observado a los supuestos diplomáticos de la embajada cubana aquí presentes —a quienes permitimos estar aquí en virtud de un tratado— gritando, intimidando y grabando no solo a nuestros expresos políticos recién liberados, sino también a otras personas", declaró Waltz a periodistas en Nueva York.
"Año tras año, el régimen cubano acude a la Asamblea General y difunde una mentira a través de su resolución anual (...) Utiliza una excusa tras otra para justificar su opresión, la miseria del pueblo cubano, y lo que estamos haciendo aquí, en la misión de Estados Unidos ante la ONU, es desenmascarar esas mentiras", afirmó.
Se espera que la votación tenga lugar el 27 y 28 de octubre, según informaron fuentes oficiales.
Estados Unidos lleva más de 60 años manteniendo un embargo comercial contra Cuba, y el Gobierno de Donald Trump ha ido intensificando la presión.
La votación de la ONU puede tener peso político, pero solo el Congreso de Estados Unidos puede levantar el embargo de la época de la Guerra Fría.
Cuba ha achacado a las sanciones estadounidenses la crisis en la que se encuentra sumida el país, la peor recesión económica en décadas, caracterizada por la escasez de productos básicos, el colapso de las infraestructuras y una inflación galopante.
"Estados Unidos está actuando como un delincuente internacional, imponiendo un castigo colectivo al pueblo de Cuba. Están infligiendo un sufrimiento inmenso a toda la población de una nación pacífica", declaró Guzmán en una reunión improvisada celebrada a las puertas de la reunión estadounidense con los disidentes.

items.title: Milho e soja caem para mínimas de várias semanas com colheita intensa nos EUA
items.author: Karl Plume
items.creator: Karl Plume
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do milho e soja dos EUA caíram para novas mínimas em várias semanas nesta segunda-feira, à medida que os fundos liquidaram posições compradas em meio à colheita em pleno andamento no Meio-Oeste e às previsões de que o clima continuará favorável nesta semana.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do milho e soja dos EUA caíram para novas mínimas em várias semanas nesta segunda-feira, à medida que os fundos liquidaram posições compradas em meio à colheita em pleno andamento no Meio-Oeste e às previsões de que o clima continuará favorável nesta semana.
O milho registrou queda pela quinta sessão consecutiva, e a soja pelo sexto dia seguido, atingindo níveis mínimos não observados desde agosto.
Os futuros do trigo seguiram a tendência de queda do milho e da soja, ignorando as preocupações com as exportações de grãos do Mar Negro em meio à guerra em curso entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia.
Espera-se que os agricultores dos EUA produzam este ano a maior safra de soja da história e a segunda maior safra de milho, e as condições climáticas para a colheita melhoraram desde que chuvas isoladas interromperam os trabalhos no campo em algumas áreas na semana passada.
"Tivemos uma janela de colheita absolutamente aberta no fim de semana", disse Ted Seifried, estrategista-chefe de mercado da Zaner Ag Hedge. "Portanto, estamos vendo pressão da colheita e, mais uma vez, os fundos parecem estar liquidando suas posições compradas."
O contrato de milho para dezembro na bolsa de Chicago fechou em queda de 7,25 centavos, a US$4,67 o bushel, seu menor nível em quase 10 semanas. O contrato de soja para novembro caiu 7,75 centavos, atingindo a menor cotação em mais de sete semanas, a US$12,535 o bushel, já que a pressão da colheita mais do que compensou o apoio da renovada demanda chinesa por importações.
O Departamento de Agricultura dos EUA (USDA) confirmou nesta segunda-feira a compra de 114.000 toneladas métricas de soja norte-americana pela China, após vários anúncios diários de "vendas relâmpago" de exportação na semana passada.
O contrato de trigo registrou queda de 5,25 centavos, para US$6,5525 o bushel, seu menor nível desde 12 de agosto.

items.title: Café arábica tem maior cotação em 1 mês em meio à valorização da moeda brasileira
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE atingiram a maior cotação em um mês nesta segunda-feira, em meio a estoques em bolsa ainda criticamente baixos e à valorização da moeda do Brasil, principal produtor. O cacau também subiu, enquanto o açúcar caiu.
items.body:
Os contratos futuros do café arábica na bolsa ICE atingiram a maior cotação em um mês nesta segunda-feira, em meio a estoques em bolsa ainda criticamente baixos e à valorização da moeda do Brasil, principal produtor. O cacau também subiu, enquanto o açúcar caiu.
CAFÉ * O café arábica fechou com alta de 10,1 centavos, ou 3,3%, a US$3,157 por libra-peso, após ter subido 6,5% na semana passada. Mais cedo, atingiu a maior cotação em um mês, de US$3,1775.
* O que impulsionou os preços do café foi o real brasileiro , que se valorizou nesta segunda-feira após um debate televisivo na noite de domingo entre o candidato de direita Flávio Bolsonaro e o de esquerda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, que, segundo alguns analistas, favoreceu ligeiramente o primeiro.
* Um real forte desestimula os exportadores a vender, já que reduz os ganhos em moeda local.
* Os estoques certificados pela ICE estavam em 239.852 sacas, não muito distantes da mínima de 27 anos registrada no mês passado, de 217.646 sacas.
* Os participantes do mercado estão ficando cada vez mais apreensivos com a possibilidade de que os suprimentos do Brasil não cheguem aos armazéns da ICE antes do vencimento do contrato de dezembro.
* O preço do café robusta subiu 2,2%, para US$3.480 por tonelada métrica.
* A produção de café do Vietnã, principal produtor de robusta, provavelmente permanecerá estável na safra 2026/27, já que a produção mais forte proveniente de árvores mais jovens e replantadas compensa as perdas relacionadas às condições climáticas desfavoráveis no início deste ano.
* O alívio para os mercados globais pode ser relativamente breve, no entanto, já que o fenômeno climático El Niño deste ano deve impactar fortemente a safra da próxima temporada.
CACAU * O contrato de cacau de Londres fechou com alta de 24 libras, ou 0,6%, a 4.380 libras por tonelada, após atingir uma máxima de um mês e meio de 4.640 libras na quarta-feira, em meio a sinais de melhora na demanda pela matéria-prima do chocolate.
* As chegadas de cacau aos portos da Costa do Marfim, principal produtor, atingiram 37.000 toneladas métricas na semana encerrada em 18 de outubro, segundo estimativas dos exportadores, uma queda de 55,9% em relação à mesma semana do ano anterior.
* O tempo seco na maior parte do cinturão de cacau da Costa do Marfim na semana passada gerou preocupações quanto a possíveis danos para a safra do próximo ano, segundo os agricultores.
* O contrato de futuros de cacau de Nova York subiu 0,7%, para US$5.687 por tonelada, após ter atingido uma máxima de um mês na última quarta-feira.
AÇÚCAR * O açúcar bruto fechou em queda de 0,28 centavo, ou 1,3%, a 20,57 centavos por libra-peso, após ter atingido uma máxima de 19 meses, de 21,29, na última quarta-feira.
* O açúcar está se consolidando após uma alta provocada pelas chuvas excessivas associadas ao El Niño no Brasil, principal produtor, o que desacelerou a produção em setembro e reduziu o teor de sacarose na cana.
* Em outros mercados, as ações das empresas açucareiras indianas caíram depois que o governo determinou que as empresas reduzissem a zero o desvio de açúcar para a produção de etanol no ano 2026/27.
* A medida visa aumentar a disponibilidade doméstica de açúcar e amenizar os preços recordes na Índia, maior consumidor mundial de açúcar e segundo maior produtor.
* O preço do açúcar branco caiu 1,5%, para US$546,80 a tonelada.

items.title: Musk Powers Republican PACs to $367 Million Fundraising Haul
items.summary:
Powered by Elon Musk’s $178 million in donations, two Republican super political action committees raked in $367 million in the third quarter, adding to the prodigious financial advantage the GOP enjoys even as its odds for holding its House and Senate majorities grow longer. The Senate Leadership Fund reported $273 million in fundraising, according to Thursday filings with the Federal Election Commission, a total that includes $158 million in contributions from Musk as well as seven-figure donations from billionaires Stephen Schwarzman, Joe Ricketts and Stephen Wynn.

For more, we speak with Bill Allison, Bloomberg News Campaign Finance Reporter. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: US, Cuba trade barbs at UN ahead of sanctions vote
items.author: Antoni Slodkowski
items.creator: Antoni Slodkowski
items.summary: The United States and Cuba traded accusations at the United Nations on Monday after US diplomats hosted an event featuring Cuban dissidents ahead of next week's annual UN vote on a resolution calling for an end to a US embargo on the island.
items.body:
The United States and Cuba traded accusations at the United Nations on Monday after US diplomats hosted an event featuring Cuban dissidents ahead of next week's annual UN vote on a resolution calling for an end to a US embargo on the island.
Cuban ambassador to the UN, Ernesto Soberón Guzmán, and other representatives yelled at the US ambassador to the UN, Mike Waltz, as he left the event at the UN building, which focused on allegations of human rights abuses by the Cuban government.
The tensions between the two nations are rising before the vote on the non-binding resolution, which has passed in the UN General Assembly by wide margins every year since 1992, and amid mounting strain from a US-imposed oil blockade on Cuba.
"I hope you...noted the so-called diplomats from the Cuban embassy here that we allow here by dint of treaty, harassing, yelling, intimidating, and filming not only our just released former political prisoners but others," Waltz told reporters in New York.
"Year after year, the Cuban regime comes to the General Assembly and propagates a lie through its annual resolution...It uses excuse after excuse to justify its oppression, to justify the misery of the Cuban people, and what we are doing here at the US mission to the UN is exposing those lies," he said.
The vote is expected to take place on Oct. 27-28, officials said.
The US has maintained a trade embargo on Cuba for more than 60 years and US President Donald Trump's administration has been stepping up the pressure, after using the military in January to remove Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.
The UN vote can carry political weight, but only the US Congress can lift the Cold War-era embargo.
Cuba has blamed US sanctions for the crisis the country is mired in, the worst economic downturn in decades characterized by shortages of basic goods, collapsing infrastructure and runaway inflation.
"The US is acting as an international delinquent, enforcing collective punishment on the people of Cuba. They are inflicting immense suffering upon the whole population of a peaceful nation," Guzmán, the Cuban ambassador, said at an impromptu gathering outside the US meeting with dissidents.
Last month, Trump [USN:L1N45E0LQ TEXT:"said"] at the UN that Cuba was a failed state and freedom would be coming to the island nation.
Cuba's electrical grid [USN:S0N44A00N TEXT:"suffered a total collapse last month"], plunging it into darkness and leaving millions without power.

items.title: Haemonetics says FDA clears vascular closure device
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Haemonetics said on Monday the US Food and Drug Administration approved its device designed to seal arterial openings created during minimally invasive heart and vascular procedures.
items.body:
Haemonetics (HAE.N) said on Monday the US Food and Drug Administration approved its device designed to seal arterial openings created during minimally invasive heart and vascular procedures.
Shares of the medical technology company rose about 1.2% in extended trading.
The device, PerQseal Elite, uses a fully absorbable patch that dissolves over time and does not leave a permanent implant in the body
Haemonetics obtained the technology as part of its January 2026 acquisition of Ireland-based Vivasure Medical
FDA's approval covers use of the device with large access sheaths commonly used in structural heart and endovascular procedures
Haemonetics said physicians can confirm if bleeding has stopped without losing guidewire access during the procedure
The company also said it will present additional clinical data at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics conference later this month
Haemonetics sells blood collection, blood management and interventional medical products, including vascular closure technologies used in cardiovascular procedures
