ユーロは０．２４％安の１．１２１２ドル。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐに拡大し、２０１１─１２年の欧州債務危機以来の水準で取引された。

主要通貨バスケットに対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．１７％高の１０１．９７。

ドルは、ＡＩ関連株が先週の急落から反発したことを受けて上昇した。先週は、ＡＩ株に対する熱狂の後退が資本流入を細らせ、ドル需要を減退させるとの懸念からドルが押し下げられていた。

カナダドルは対米ドルで０．２７％高の１米ドル＝１．４１カナダドル。カナダ銀行（中銀）のマックレム総裁が１７日に示したタカ派的な発言が通貨を下支えした。

産油州であるアルバータ州では１９日、同州がカナダから分離独立すべきかどうかを問う住民投票が実施される。

円は対ドルで０．３５％下落し、１ドル＝１５８．４９円。

Oct 19 : A Siberian cave already famous for yielding the first remains of an extinct human lineage called the Denisovans, who once roamed widely in Eurasia, has now produced evidence of a previously unknown large Ice Age mammal closely related to today's yak.
Researchers said they discovered small bone fragments of the animal in Denisova Cave in the Altai Mountains of southern Siberia in Russia, and obtained DNA that showed these remains belonged to a bovine species distinct from others already known, living and extinct.
In all, the researchers studied 20 bone fragments from this species — 14 from Denisova Cave and 6 from other sites in the broader region. The oldest specimen dated to about 250,000 to 200,000 years ago, and the youngest to about 27,000 years ago.
The bones themselves were so fragmentary that their shape alone did not reveal that they belonged to a previously unknown large mammal. But the researchers were able to generate 20 ancient genomes from the bones, and these showed that this was a unique species whose evolutionary lineage diverged from the ancestors of the modern-day yak approximately 400,000 years ago.

"It is unusual, especially to recognize a large mammal species from small, unidentifiable fragments," said evolutionary geneticist Love Dalén of the Centre for Palaeogenetics, a collaboration between Stockholm University and the Swedish Museum of Natural History, senior author of the research published in the journal Current Biology.
"I'd say that this is related to the advances in the field of ancient DNA, as genetics is a powerful new layer of information applied to ancient materials," said Alexandre Gilardet, a doctoral student at the Centre for Palaeogenetics and co-lead author of the study, along with Centre for Palaeogenetics postdoctoral researcher Jonas Oppenheimer.
Genetic evidence alone is not sufficient to allow for giving a scientific name to a new species, so the researchers are calling this one "Yak X."
THE ICE AGE LANDSCAPE
Dalén said Yak X lived alongside other bovines including steppe bison and the aurochs, the extinct wild ancestor of today's domesticated cattle. It also shared the Ice Age landscape with woolly mammoths, woolly rhinoceroses, horses and large predators such as cave hyenas and brown bears, Dalén said.
"I'd expect it to have looked more like a yak than a bison, given its close relationship to modern yaks," Dalén said.
Yaks are sturdily built animals with horns, long fur and a hump at the shoulders, looking a bit like a hairy ox. The largest males can weigh as much as a ton. Wild yaks are restricted to higher elevations of the Tibetan Plateau.
The Yak X discovery deepens the understanding of the diversity of large Ice Age mammals and adds another species to the long list that disappeared at around the end of that epoch.
"Using the long, 200,000-year time span of our sampling, we can see that the species may have undergone a population decline during a period of warming around 120,000 years ago, and went extinct some time after our youngest sample, about 27,000 years ago," Oppenheimer said.
The vast Siberian expanse was a grassland ecosystem called the mammoth steppe, known as such for its largest denizens. Most of the region was left uncovered by the immense ice sheets that had blanketed large swathes of North America and Europe.
The Yak X lineage diverged from the ancestors of modern yaks around the same time as the evolutionary split that occurred between the ursine lineages that led to today's brown bears and polar bears.
THE DENISOVANS
It was in Denisova Cave in 2008 that scientists unearthed a finger bone that offered the first evidence of the existence of Denisovans, extinct cousins of Neanderthals and our own species, Homo sapiens. Since then, more remains of Denisovans have been discovered in the cave and in several far-flung parts of Asia.
Some modern populations of people, especially those in Melanesia and Papua New Guinea, carry a small percentage of DNA from Denisovans, indicating interbreeding with Homo sapiens before the Denisovans became extinct under circumstances that are not well understood.
Denisovans were hunter-gatherers who survived in many different types of environments. The Yak X species might have been among the prey that they hunted.
"It seems reasonable that Yak X was on the Denisovan menu," Dalén said.

Source: Reuters

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反落して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．６３％安と、７営業日ぶりの反落。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．３３％安。銀行大手のバークレイズは３．５％下落。プライベートクレジット融資に関する流動性などのリスクを過小評価するような不適切な表示をした疑いでイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が調査していると伝わった。

鉱業株指数は２．６５％安。銅価格の値下がりを受けて、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは４．１％、グレンコアは３．３％、それぞれ下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．３７％、公益事業株指数は２．１３％、それぞれ値下がりした。通期生産見通しを引き下げた石油・ガス会社セリカ・エナジーは２．０％下落した。

ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案公表を来週に控える中、今週は消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）や小売売上高といった英経済指標が発表される。多くの企業決算も開示される予定となっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

４営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。２０２７年に大統領選を控えるフランスで、物価高や公共サービスの悪化に抗議するデモが拡大し、政局が混迷しつつある。財政を巡る懸念も相場の重荷となり、フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．１１％下落した。このほか、総選挙を１１月に控えて政治的な不透明感が強まったスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数も１．４９％安だった。

フランスの金融機関ＢＮＰパリバ、クレディ・アグリコル、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは２．５─３．４％下落。フランスの小売大手カルフールは２．２％、ショッピングセンターなどを手がけるウニベイル・ロダムコ・ウエストフィールドは２．１％それぞれ値下がりした。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は２．０７％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．４３％安。

一方、テクノロジー株指数は０．７０％上昇。

今週は、ドイツのソフトウエア大手ＳＡＰ、フィンランドの通信機器大手ノキア、英銀大手のバークレイズの決算発表が予定されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが上昇した。週末にフランス全土で抗議活動が繰り広げられたことを受け、巨額の財政赤字削減が同国政府にとっていかに困難かが浮き彫りとなった。

フランスでは１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展。商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

投資家は、フランスが財政を立て直すには予算案を可決する必要があると指摘しているが、今回の抗議デモはそれがいかに難しいかを示している。来年の大統領選を控えた政治的な駆け引きが、事態をさらに複雑にする可能性もある。

ＳＭＢＣのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ハンク・カレンティ氏は、財政赤字削減や年金改革の取り組みに言及し「抗議デモが繰り広げられた週末を経てこうした動きになったことは、改革への期待が後退していることを示している」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは１３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９％と、１日としては９月下旬以来の上昇幅となる見通しとなった。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の３．４５％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４６ｂｐと、２週間ぶりの高水準となった。それでも、１０月序盤に付けた１６０ｂｐ近辺からは縮小している。  

イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ上昇の４．５８％。

欧州市場サマリー（19日）
3:50 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反落して取引を終えた。銀行や鉱業株が売られ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は４営業日ぶりに反落した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．６３％安と、７営業日ぶりの反落。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．３３％安。銀行大手のバークレイズは３．５％下落。プライベートクレジット融資に関する流動性などのリスクを過小評価するような不適切な表示をした疑いでイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が調査していると伝わった。

鉱業株指数は２．６５％安。銅価格の値下がりを受けて、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは４．１％、グレンコアは３．３％、それぞれ下落した。

航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．３７％、公益事業株指数は２．１３％、それぞれ値下がりした。通期生産見通しを引き下げた石油・ガス会社セリカ・エナジーは２．０％下落した。

ヒーリー英財務相による初の予算案公表を来週に控える中、今週は消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）や小売売上高といった英経済指標が発表される。多くの企業決算も開示される予定となっている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

４営業日ぶりに反落して取引を終えた。２０２７年に大統領選を控えるフランスで、物価高や公共サービスの悪化に抗議するデモが拡大し、政局が混迷しつつある。財政を巡る懸念も相場の重荷となり、フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．１１％下落した。このほか、総選挙を１１月に控えて政治的な不透明感が強まったスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数も１．４９％安だった。

フランスの金融機関ＢＮＰパリバ、クレディ・アグリコル、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは２．５─３．４％下落。フランスの小売大手カルフールは２．２％、ショッピングセンターなどを手がけるウニベイル・ロダムコ・ウエストフィールドは２．１％それぞれ値下がりした。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は２．０７％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種航空宇宙・防衛株指数は１．４３％安。

一方、テクノロジー株指数は０．７０％上昇。

今週は、ドイツのソフトウエア大手ＳＡＰ、フィンランドの通信機器大手ノキア、英銀大手のバークレイズの決算発表が予定されている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが上昇した。週末にフランス全土で抗議活動が繰り広げられたことを受け、巨額の財政赤字削減が同国政府にとっていかに困難かが浮き彫りとなった。

フランスでは１７日、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、同国で過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展。商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。

投資家は、フランスが財政を立て直すには予算案を可決する必要があると指摘しているが、今回の抗議デモはそれがいかに難しいかを示している。来年の大統領選を控えた政治的な駆け引きが、事態をさらに複雑にする可能性もある。

ＳＭＢＣのグローバル市場ストラテジスト、ハンク・カレンティ氏は、財政赤字削減や年金改革の取り組みに言及し「抗議デモが繰り広げられた週末を経てこうした動きになったことは、改革への期待が後退していることを示している」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは１３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９％と、１日としては９月下旬以来の上昇幅となる見通しとなった。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の３．４５％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４６ｂｐと、２週間ぶりの高水準となった。それでも、１０月序盤に付けた１６０ｂｐ近辺からは縮小している。  

イタリア１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ上昇の４．５８％。

items.title: トランプ氏、女性の健康に関する大統領令署名　ＮＩＨに新部門創設へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１９日、メラニア夫人とともに、女性の健康に焦点を当てたホワイトハウスのタスクフォース（作業部会）と国立衛生研究所（ＮＩＨ）の部門を創設する大統領令に署名した。

トランプ氏はホワイトハウスでのイベントで、タスクフォースはスージー・ワイルズ大統領首席補佐官と、ケネディ厚生長官が主導すると表明。タスクフォースは１９日に初会合を開くと明らかにした。

トランプ氏は「大統領令は、保健福祉省（ＨＨＳ）に対し、ＮＩＨ内に新たな女性の健康部門を設立するよう指示するものだ」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスのファクトシートによると、同大統領令は連邦政府に対し、女性の人生のあらゆる段階にわたって包括的に健康問題に取り組むよう指示するもので、予防、診断、治療を加速させるための研究を強化し、研究成果を臨床実践や政策に反映させることを目指す。

ＮＩＨに新設される「女性の健康部門」は、同機関の「女性の健康研究室」に取って代わるものではなく、連携して機能する。

ホワイトハウスは、今回の措置は政府の取り組みを研究の枠を超えて広げ、研究成果を女性や少女のための臨床ケアへと応用することを優先するためのものだと説明した。

items.title: 米メタ、「反トランプ」デモ主催者のインスタ一時停止巡り陳謝
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズは、全米各地で１７日に開催されたトランプ米政権に対する抗議活動「ＮＯ　ＫＩＮＧＳ（王はいらない）」の主催者や参加者が利用していたインスタグラムのアカウントが活動中に一時停止されていたと明らかにした。メタの担当者は「心からおわびする」と陳謝した。

アカウント停止の理由について、利用が短期間に集中した際、通常の閲覧ではなく、特定の作業を自動処理する「ボット」によるものと似たアクセスが増えたためだと説明している。

１７日には数千の集会が開かれ、参加者はトランプ大統領による強硬な移民政策やイラン攻撃などを非難し、１１月３日の米中間選挙の期日前投票を呼びかけた。その際、参加者らのインスタグラムのアカウントが１時間超、利用できなくなった。

メタの広報担当アンディ・ストーン氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）Ｘへの投稿で、復旧作業に時間がかかったと説明。セキュリティーシステムで、投稿やハッシュタグを読み取る人工知能（ＡＩ）ツール「クロード」の使用急増が検知され、「自動保護機能が誤ってアカウントを停止した」と説明した。

集会主催者は１９日、ＳＮＳブルースカイで「インスタグラムの停止だけでなく、抗議活動や期日前投票に関する内容がメタのプラットフォーム全体でアクセスができなくなったり、制限されたりしたとの報告を受けている」と指摘。「選挙を数週間後に控え、謝罪だけでは不十分だ。説明責任を果たすことや具体的な対策が必要だ」と訴えた。

FAST

MUMBAI, Oct 19 : Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance said on Monday that Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock and Fidelity were among investors who bid in the anchor book of its record $3.2 billion Jio Platforms IPO, which two sources said drew more than $25 billion in demand.
The telecoms, cloud and AI group on Monday opened its record initial public offering to institutional investors who can bid for up to 30 per cent of the offering exclusively earmarked for them, before the issue opens for public subscription on Wednesday. 
Jio Platforms allocated shares worth over 81 billion rupees ($853.31 million) to anchor investors, a company filing showed on Monday.
State-run insurer Life Insurance Corporation, French lender BNP Paribas, JPMorgan, India's largest private-sector lender HDFC Bank were among the other institutions allotted shares in the IPO anchor book.

The bids drawn were over 30 times the quota reserved for anchor investors, a source told Reuters.
Jio upended India's telecoms market in 2016 by offering free voice calls and cheap data and soon became the country's biggest mobile operator. It now has more than 500 million subscribers and competes with Bharti Airtel and Vodafone Idea.
Its listing is seen as a test of what global investors will pay for that scale and for Jio's expansion into cloud and AI.
Led by Mukesh Ambani's son Akash Ambani, Jio operates Reliance Industries' telecom and digital businesses, spanning mobile services, fixed broadband, cloud, entertainment, enterprise technology and AI offerings.
Jio's IPO follows September's listing of the National Stock Exchange of India, underscoring investor appetite for large offerings in the Indian market. It will be the first offering by Reliance since its listing of Reliance Petroleum in 2006.
Year-to-date Indian IPO proceeds rose 8.3 per cent to $12.65 billion compared with the same period last year, LSEG data shows.
A successful IPO would place Jio Platforms among the top four Indian listed companies by market capitalisation, behind its parent Reliance, its rival Bharti Airtel and the country's largest private lender HDFC Bank.
Jio plans to use up to 275 billion Indian rupees ($2.90 billion) of the net proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings of its telecom subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm.
($1 = 94.9475 Indian rupees)

items.title: 米ロッキードと「パトリオット」供給加速巡り協議＝ゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１９日、ロシアの弾道ミサイル迎撃に不可欠な地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」の供給を加速させる方法について、米防衛大手ロッキード・マーチンの代表者と協議したと明らかにした。

ゼレンスキー氏は「ロシアの弾道ミサイルやジェットエンジン式ドローン（無人機）に対する防衛で、ロッキード・マーチンが製造するパトリオット・システムのほか、Ｆ１６戦闘機が重要な役割を果たしている」と通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿。「現在、いずれの面でも容易な状況ではない。供給をどのように拡大し、増強できるか協議した」とした。

ロシアはこの日の未明にかけて、ウクライナ全土に対する広範な攻撃を実施。ゼレンスキー氏は、同盟国から事前の警告を受けていなかったと明らかにしている。

Oct 19 : Netflix said on Monday its film division head Dan Lin would leave after nearly three years at the helm, marking a second senior executive departure in less than a week amid concerns over slowing engagement.
The company said on Thursday content chief Bela Bajaria would leave after nearly a decade with the streaming platform, and would be replaced by former Disney executive Peter Rice.
• Rice will oversee the films division until a new head is announced
• Netflix's growth prospects and user engagement are under scrutiny; its co-CEO Ted Sarandos recently said the company is "not growing as fast as I want us to"

• During his tenure at Netflix, Lin oversaw "KPop Demon Hunters," which became a breakout hit for Netflix and won an Academy Award, bolstering the streamer's feature animation strategy
• Lin, one of the producers of "Sherlock Holmes" and the Lego movies, has worked as a senior executive for Warner Bros Pictures

NEW YORK, Oct 19 : IT services company DXC Technology is in advanced talks to sell its insurance software and services division to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.
Eldridge is discussing combining the business with Zinnia, its insurance technology platform that provides software and digital infrastructure to life insurance and annuity providers, the sources said.
An agreement could be reached in the coming weeks, although there is no certainty a deal will be finalized, the people said, requesting anonymity because the discussions are confidential.
DXC Technology, Eldridge and Zinnia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

The transaction would mark a significant divestiture for DXC as the information technology services provider seeks to streamline its portfolio after several years of declining revenue. 
The sale would allow DXC to exit a business that provides technology and outsourcing services to insurers globally, helping the IT services provider streamline its operations after several years of declining revenue. Its insurance division offers policy administration systems and other software and business process services to insurers across life, wealth, property and casualty markets. 
For Eldridge, a transaction would combine Zinnia's life and annuity technology platform with DXC Technology's insurance software and business-process services operations, creating a scaled provider of software, administration and servicing technology for insurers.

items.title: イスラエル、ガザへの商業物資搬入再開へ　税巡る対立解消
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ １９日 ロイター] - イスラエルは１９日、パレスチナ自治区ガザへの商業物資の搬入を再開すると発表した。援助に依存するガザへの食料など生活必需品の重要な供給ルートが復活する。物資搬入は、パレスチナのイスラム組織ハマスと商人の間の課税を巡る対立で数日間停止していた。

ガザでの人道問題を管轄するイスラエル軍機関「ＣＯＧＡＴ」は、ハマス当局がトラック１台当たり１万シェケル（３２２５ドル）の支払い要求を取り下げたと商人側が報告したことを受け、再開を決定したと説明した。

ＣＯＧＡＴは「調整の再開は、停戦合意の人道的条項を順守するというイスラエルの約束に沿って実施される」と表明した。商人側の説明は独自には確認できていないとした上で、搬入は段階的に再開し、冬を前に生活必需品が優先されるとした。

支払いが銀行振込を通じてのみ行われ、記録に残る形で授受されるよう監視を強化する。ハマスに支払いを行ったことが判明した商人はシステムから排除されるという。

ハマスは、１万シェケルの費用は戦禍で荒廃した地域で困窮者を支援する「基金」への裕福なガザ住民による任意の拠出だと説明している。

FAST

LONDON, Oct 19 : S&P Global estimates the world's biggest tech firms are likely to have more AI-linked liabilities than currently known, although its top analyst for the sector sees no need to change any ratings at present.
Debt issued by AI infrastructure providers and so-called 'neocloud' firms such as Nvidia-backed CoreWeave has sunk to increasingly stressed levels in recent weeks amid concerns about the aggressive scale of their borrowing.
S&P's Global Head for Digital Infrastructure Mark Habib said the biggest risk to hyperscalers' ratings remained whether expected profits fail to materialise.
But he also highlighted so-called 'interconnected financing structures', where hyperscalers effectively guarantee huge data centre builds, or smaller AI companies.

"It is safe to assume that there is more (debt) out there that we are not seeing," Habib said during a roundtable in London.
"If it's not reported, then it's not part of the disclosure by the hyperscalers. Also, if we are not rating the transactions where this liability may accrue, then the fact of the matter is that we might not have the visibility."
S&P expects the top six US hyperscalers — Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Oracle, Meta, and SpaceX — to spend more than $7 trillion on data centers and other AI-related capex between 2025 and 2030, and have negative free cash flow until at least next year.
Habib said there wasn't an estimate of how much additional debt the circular financing might add to firms' balance sheets, although he said S&P was trying to take a "holistic" view overall.
Back in July, it downgraded Oracle to BBB-, the lowest rung of 'investment grade', on concerns about its AI spending and what it called "an uncertain path to profitability".
Habib was also asked whether the recent market selloff of bonds linked to the aggressive AI buildout was a sign that investors see them as riskier than ratings indicate.
"For now, we don't have the view that there is a major disconnect that needs to force our ratings to change at this point," he said, saying S&P's scores were designed to take a longer-term view.
He said what could change that view was if it became clear the amount of money being spent was no longer sustainable.
"And that could come from a variety of drivers," Habib said. "Further increases in the investments (by AI firms), or a view that the revenue rate of competition is getting too intense."

Source: Reuters

items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Unilever said on Monday it has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms of the sale.
items.body:
Unilever (ULVR.L) said on Monday it has agreed to sell Welly Health PBC to private-equity firm Forward Consumer Partners, but did not disclose financial terms of the sale.
The consumer products giant had acquired a majority stake in the US brand, known for its colorful adhesive bandages, in 2021 from Welly co-founder Eric Ryan for an undisclosed price.
The deal, first reported by the Wall Street Journal, is expected to close in the fourth quarter, subject to customary closing conditions
Separately, Forward Consumer Partners announced that Ryan will return to the business as a strategic advisor and a member of the board
Unilever, the maker of Knorr stock cubes and Hellmann's mayonnaise, has been shifting towards beauty and well-being brands under CEO Fernando Fernandez
Forward said the acquisition of Welly would mark its first investment in the consumer health sector

items.title: Eagles quarterback Hurts set to miss rest of season due to blood clots
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has blood clots in both lungs, the team and his agent said on Monday, and media reports said the former Super Bowl MVP was expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season.
items.body:
Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has blood clots in both lungs, the team and his agent said on Monday, and media reports said the former Super Bowl MVP was expected to miss the rest of the 2026 season.
Hurts is clinically stable and his treatment should only involve blood thinners, which will rule him out of contact activities, the Eagles and agent Nicole Lynn said in a statement.
The 28-year-old was initially diagnosed with a left calf superficial vein thrombosis after an ultrasound in London before Philadelphia's 19-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, which Hurts played in.
The current diagnosis is a deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli. A bilateral pulmonary embolism is where a blood clot travels from a deep vein in the body, often the leg, and blocks an artery in both lungs.
"Jalen's prognosis is very good, and we expect a full recovery. We anticipate that he will have the opportunity to resume contact football activities when off the blood thinners," the statement said, adding no long-term effects are expected.
According to an ESPN report, Hurts was in the hospital in London until 4 a.m. on the day of the game and did not sleep the night before the contest as a health precaution.
Speaking at a press conference on Monday, Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni said that the team care deeply about their players and that he trusts the team's medical staff.
"I'm a football coach. I lean on our medical experts in every situation. I have full trust and full faith in them," Sirianni said.
"We get medical information from our guys, and we always put the players' health first and foremost in every situation. And, you know, that's where we were there."
The Eagles said in a statement on Thursday that their medical staff and doctors in London reviewed the ultrasound results and concluded that "activity and mobility were important" and that Hurts could safely play in the game against the Jaguars, adding that he "played without limitation".
Hurts guided the Eagles to the Super Bowl title in February 2025, throwing for two touchdowns and running in another against the Kansas City Chiefs to earn the game's Most Valuable Player trophy.

items.title: Canadian firms' outlooks dimmed after trade talks collapse, BoC survey finds
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Promit Mukherjee and David Ljunggren
items.body:
By Promit Mukherjee and David Ljunggren
OTTAWA, Oct 19 (Reuters) - Canadian firms reported their outlooks had deteriorated after the collapse of trade talks with the United States but sentiments remained considerably stronger than at the peak of tensions last year, the Bank of Canada said on Monday.
A survey of around 340 business leaders in September showed that since the talks broke down on August 21, new US tariffs and Canadian counter tariffs had weighed on their outlooks.
The bank said this suggested "a moderation rather than a fundamental shift in firms' outlooks".
A separate Business Outlook Survey for the third quarter, which was largely carried out before the talks collapsed, showed overall sentiment had improved.
But both surveys pointed to higher inflation expectations amid increase input costs and elevated selling prices due to trade tensions and the Middle East crisis.
The studies help the BoC decide the trajectory of inflation and feed into its decision for the monetary policy.
Money markets are pricing in a hold in interest rates by the BoC on October 28, but see a 25 basis point rise in December.
Governor Tiff Macklem says while headline inflation has risen, this is primarily due by higher energy costs and there are so far no signs of a spillover into other components.
But he also says he is ready to hike rates if higher prices show signs of feeding into the broader economy.
The leaders' survey reported weaker export sales, the BoC said, adding that the improving sentiment at the beginning of the third quarter had partially reversed.
"Nevertheless, sentiment and expectations remain considerably stronger than at the height of trade tensions in 2025," it added.
In the Business Outlook Survey, the central bank said while there were some improvements in demand, firms' hiring intentions remained soft, but most firms intend to retain existing employees. Expectations for wage growth are largely unchanged, the survey noted.
The business outlook indicator, a metric of prospects under current economic conditions, edged up to -0.33 in the third quarter from -0.38 in the prior three months.
A separate survey by the central bank on consumer expectations showed that more than 50% of consumers surveyed expect a recession over the next 12 months and expectations for five-year inflation had also risen.
((Reuters Ottawa bureau))

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 19 : Retailer Ahold Delhaize reported a cybersecurity incident to Dutch police on Monday after it detected suspicious activity in its infrastructure, the company said, adding it took some systems offline as a precaution earlier this month.
Although only reported to the police on Monday, the incident coincided with a cyberattack in France that caused refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of stores to heat up to 50 degrees Celsius (122 degrees Fahrenheit) overnight, sparking fires and spoiling food.
The Dutch National Cyber Security Centre said there was no reason to believe the incident in the Netherlands was directly linked to any cyberattacks in other countries.
Delhaize said its investigations found the suspicious activity had resulted from the "malicious actions of others", without specifying who might be responsible.

"Taking systems offline to help protect them was a precautionary measure that affected most of our brands across Europe and the United States. The investigation to date confirms this was the right decision", President and CEO Frans Muller said.
NO ONLINE ORDERS BEFORE THURSDAY
Earlier on Monday, Ahold Delhaize's Albert Heijn, the Netherlands' largest supermarket chain, said it would not resume online deliveries before Thursday at the earliest, extending to at least 11 days an outage caused by the cybersecurity incident.
Online accounts for about 10 per cent of Albert Heijn sales.
While Albert Heijn's website was back online on Monday, the websites of Ahold Delhaize’s US chains remained offline, a week after the cyber incident forced the company to shut down some of its IT systems. Ahold Delhaize said it expected e-commerce services at its US brands to resume "in the coming days".
The US brands, which include Stop & Shop, Giant Food, Hannaford and Food Lion, collectively rank among the country’s largest food retailers. Deliveries at Belgian chain Delhaize resumed over the weekend.
Ahold Delhaize previously said that there was no evidence that any customer data had been stolen.
Physical stores of several chains have remained open, but have struggled with supplies as distribution channels were also affected.

items.title: Monedas suben en medio de respiro en favor activos de más riesgo; Brasil espera balotaje
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, aunque en una jornada de cotizaciones en rangos estrechos, pese a un leve avance del dólar en los mercados globales y una cotización dispar de los precios del crudo, con los mercados de Brasil a la espera del balotaje presidencial.
items.body:
La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, aunque en una jornada de cotizaciones en rangos estrechos, pese a un leve avance del dólar en los mercados globales y una cotización dispar de los precios del crudo, con los mercados de Brasil a la espera del balotaje presidencial.
* Los precios del petróleo terminaron mixtos el lunes, con el contrato WTI de Estados Unidos anotando una fuerte alza y el referencial Brent una ligera baja, tras los ataques perpetrados por los hutíes contra un campo de entrenamiento militar yemení y sus nuevas incursiones contra instalaciones energéticas, aeroportuarias y militares saudíes.
* Mientras, el índice dólar , que mide al billete verde frente a una canasta de seis monedas pares, sumó un ligero 0,17%, respaldado por un repunte de las acciones del sector de la inteligencia artificial en Wall Street.
* Sólidos datos de crecimiento de China ayudaron también con el ánimo en favor del riesgo de los inversores. En el tercer trimestre, la expansión económica del gigante asiático trepó un 4,5%, rebotando desde mínimos de tres años y superando ligeramente las expectativas.
* El peso mexicano subía por la tarde un 0,3%, a 18,4258 unidades por dólar, también a la espera de datos de inflación local durante la semana. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, ganó un ligero 0,09%, a 68.994,24 puntos, en una semana marcada por el inicio de los resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre.
* "A pesar de la apreciación del peso... no pueden descartarse presiones al alza para el tipo de cambio debido a que se han reanudado las presiones al alza sobre los instrumentos del Tesoro", dijo Banco Base en un reporte.
* "El tipo de cambio suma cuatro sesiones consolidándose en un canal entre 18,40 y 18,60 pesos por dólar. Sin embargo, esto no implica un cambio de tendencia y dado que las presiones al alza persisten y son fuertes, lo más probable es que en las próximas jornadas el tipo de cambio se dirija nuevamente hacia el nivel clave de 18,50 pesos por dólar".
"Persiste el riesgo de alcanzar de nuevo el máximo en el año de 18,6033 pesos por dólar", remarcó.
* El real brasileño sumó un 0,5%, a 5,0476 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) perdió preliminarmente un 0,15%, a 205.126 puntos, en una semana en que los mercados están atentos al balotaje presidencial del fin de semana.
* Los últimos sondeos de opinión muestran una muy estrecha ventaja del senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, quien ha recortado la diferencia respecto de encuestas previas.
* El peso chileno , terminó la jornada con un alza del 0,32%, en 980,90/981,10 unidades por dólar. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , retrocedía un 0,14%, a 10.955,42 puntos.
* El peso colombiano cerró con alza de un 0,48% a 3.157,91 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice accionario de la bolsa, el MSIC COLCAP (.COLCAP) , se desvalorizó un 1,74% a 2.521,69 puntos.
* "Esta fortaleza del peso colombiano se ve influenciada por los altos precios en el petróleo, pero también por la alta tasa de interés de referencia del Banco de la República", escribió el Banco de Bogotá.
* El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,43% a 1.524,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, en medio del control de liquidez por parte del banco central (BCRA), que en la jornada sumó 18 millones de dólares a sus reservas. Mientras, el referencial de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) , se hundió un 1,84%.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un leve 0,06% a 3,4360/3,4370 unidades por dólar, tras cotizar en rojo más temprano. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) perdió un 0,11%, a 1.576 puntos.

items.title: Kenyan starvation cult leader convicted of deaths of nearly 200 children
items.author: Jefferson Kahinju
items.creator: Jefferson Kahinju
items.summary: Starvation cult leader Paul Mackenzie and 28 others were found guilty of murder by a Kenyan court on Monday over the deaths of 190 children and an adult in one of the world's worst cult-related tragedies in recent history.
items.body:
Starvation [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"cult leader Paul Mackenzie"] and 28 others were found guilty of murder by a Kenyan court on Monday over the deaths of 190 children and an adult in one of the world's worst cult-related tragedies in recent history.
The preacher was [USN:L8N3Z51Y2 TEXT:"arrested in 2023"] after police received a tip-off, and weeks later authorities began uncovering bodies in shallow graves in the Shakahola Forest near the coast in southeastern Kenya.
Prosecutors say Mackenzie and his Good News International Church organised a Christian doomsday sect in which they ordered followers to starve themselves and their children to death to go to heaven before the world ended.
The case has gripped Kenya since the discovery of the mass graves.
It raised questions over how Mackenzie was able to continue to operate despite having been on the radar of the authorities since 2017 when his premises were searched by police. In 2019, authorities shut down Mackenzie's church and he relocated to the Shakahola Forest, police said.
GRANDFATHER HAILS JUDGMENT Mackenzie denied murder charges, saying he did not force the victims to starve, but the court rejected that argument.
He and the others convicted will be sentenced on November 6. Defence lawyer Lawrence Obonyo, who represents Mackenzie and almost all of the others convicted, said he had been instructed to appeal.
Francis Wanje, 62, lost eight family members including two grandchildren to the cult. He told Reuters that the judgment made him happy and gave him confidence in the judiciary.
"So many are going to learn from what has come up today. ... You find churches everywhere, but they've got ill reasons for the churches. So it is good for members of the public to be very careful," Wanje added.
HEARING LASTED MORE THAN EIGHT HOURS In total, more than 400 bodies have been recovered from the Shakahola Forest.
Many of the children's bodies were severely decomposed, with only 26 able to be identified, and investigations into the other deaths are ongoing.
Justice Diana Kavedza Mochache said in a hearing lasting more than eight hours that in some cases children were isolated and denied food while their parents watched.
The director of public prosecutions, Renson Ingonga, told reporters afterwards at the Mombasa High Court: "That is the best judgment we would ever get."
MACKENZIE SILENT WHEN JUDGE CALLED HIM BY NAME Mackenzie was in court, wearing a striped polo shirt and red trousers, sitting alongside his wife, one of the co-accused.
When his name was read out by the judge he was silent, staring into space.
The case has led to calls for tougher oversight of churches and other religious organisations in a country where religious faith plays a prominent role in public life.
Kenyan President William Ruto said in 2023 that government agencies should have been able to prevent the deaths. He said he took responsibility as president.
CHILDREN WERE FIRST TO STARVE People with direct knowledge of the cult's activities have [USN:L8N36W0BR TEXT:"told Reuters"] that Mackenzie planned the mass starvation in three phases: first children, then women and young men, and finally the remaining men.
A former taxi driver, Mackenzie forbade cult members from sending their children to school and from going to hospital when they were ill, branding such institutions as satanic, relatives of some of his victims told Reuters for a 2023 article.
Cult members lived in makeshift homes of polythene sheeting and thatch that Mackenzie divided into areas with biblical names like Jerusalem and Judea.
The plight of his followers began to emerge in mid-March 2023, when a local man told police that his brother and wife had starved their children to death in the forest on Mackenzie's orders.
Mackenzie was arrested but released on bail, after which relatives say he brought forward the date on which he told his followers the world would end. Police arrested him again in April 2023 and started combing through the forest more systematically and began exhuming mass graves.
Mackenzie faces other charges over the forest deaths including terrorism-related ones, which he has denied.
Prosecutors say while he was in detention he also directed the deaths of 52 people in [USN:L8N3Z51Y2 TEXT:"Kwa Binzaro village"], which lies about 30 km (18 miles) from Shakahola. Mackenzie has pleaded not guilty in that case.

items.title: 中国証監会、市場安定を最優先へ　株式や債券の動向注視＝国営メディア
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[上海／北京 １９日 ロイター] - 中国国営メディアは１９日、中国証券監督管理委員会（証監会）の呉清主席が北京で開かれた金融フォーラムで、資本市場の安定を最優先する方針を示したと報じた。株式や債券、為替市場でボラティリティーや相関性が高まっているとして、リスク評価や政策手段を強化すると表明した。

呉氏は、世界市場の関連性が強まっていることを踏まえ、証監会として国内外の市場を注視し、市場安定の仕組みを改善すると述べた。市場や部門を横断して波及するリスクに細心の注意を払う必要があると指摘。新たな業態などに伴うリスクへの備えを強化するほか、中国内の個別銘柄に連動するオフショアのレバレッジ商品に関しても警戒していくと言及した。

呉氏は、市場改革の一環として、上海証券取引所のハイテク企業向け市場「科創板（スター・マーケット）」と深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」を念頭に、テクノロジー企業の選定の仕組みを改善していくと述べた。中国の資本市場の新商品拡充策の一環として、１８のアクティブ運用型上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の登録承認についても明らかにした。

世界的な人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の売り圧力を受け、中国の主要指数ＣＳＩ３００指数は、足元では１０週連続で下落している。ハイテク株中心の「科創板」５０指数は６月下旬に付けた今年のピークから４０％近く下落し、年初来の上昇分を失った。

items.title: サウジ「砂漠のダボス会議」来年に延期、フーシ派攻撃で混乱続く
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Timour Azhari　Federico Maccioni　Tala Ramadan　Alexander Cornwell

[１９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Timour Azhari　Federico Maccioni　Tala Ramadan　Alexander Cornwell

[１９日　ロイター] - サウジアラビアで２６─２９日に開催予定だった国際投資会議「フューチャー・インベストメント・イニシアチブ（ＦＩＩ）」について、主催者は１９日、２０２７年に延期すると発表した。新たな日程は近く発表するとしている。

サウジでは中東紛争の拡大に伴う一連の攻撃で国内で死傷者が出る中、経済活動が混乱。ＦＩＩの主催者は声明で「参加者が期待するイベントの規模、卓越した質、そして忘れがたいインパクトを確実に提供したい」と延期理由を説明した。

ロイターは発表に先立ち、対面形式のイベントが中止されたと報じていた。

ＦＩＩは今回で１０回目。世界有数の金融関係者や企業経営者が集うイベントとして知られ、スイスで開かれる世界経済フォーラム（ＷＥＦ）年次総会になぞらえ、「砂漠のダボス会議」と呼ばれている。草案段階のプログラムによると、今年のＦＩＩには米ゴールドマン・サックスのデービッド・ソロモン会長兼最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）、英スタンダード・チャータードのビル・ウィンターズＣＥＯ、米シティグループのジェーン・フレイザーＣＥＯらが参加する予定だった。

米国とイランの交戦を受け、当初はアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）やカタールなどで予定されていた会議が中止や延期されることがあっても、サウジへの被害は比較的限定されていた。ただここ数週間、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジに対する攻撃を激化。フーシ派はサウジ各地の軍事施設、エネルギー関連施設、民間インフラを標的にしており、国営石油会社サウジアラムコの本社やリヤド国際空港も攻撃を受け、これまでに少なくとも１８人が死亡し、数百人が負傷した。

航空データ分析会社シリウムによると、８日以降にサウジ国内の空港から出発予定だった航空便の約４５％が欠航になっている。

items.title: 米住宅建設業者指数、10月は約14年半ぶり低水準　ローン金利・建材高が重し
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン １９日 ロイター] - 全米住宅建設業協会（ＮＡＨＢ）が１９日発表した１０月のＮＡＨＢ／ウェルズ・ファーゴ住宅建設業者指数は２９と、前月の３２から低下し、２０１２年６月以来、約１４年半ぶりの低水準となった。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は３１への低下だった。

中東紛争により住宅ローン金利とエネルギー関連の建材価格が上昇しているほか、移民取り締まりに伴う人手不足や、関税措置によるコスト上昇が影響している。

住宅ローン金利はここ数週間で急上昇しており、住宅金融公社フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は先週、７．４０％と約３年ぶりの高水準となった。米国とイスラエルの対イラン戦争がインフレをあおる中、米国債利回りに連動して借り入れコストが上昇し、住宅販売を圧迫している。

ＮＡＨＢのビル・オーウェンズ会長は「住宅建設業者は、建設ローンや建築建材、ディーゼル燃料のコスト上昇に加え、慢性的な人手不足にも直面している」と指摘。「全米で建設業者の３分の１超が、過去１カ月間に自社の事業地域で移民取り締まりの動きがあったと報告しており、これが建設の遅れや、合法的な労働者が出勤を躊躇（ちゅうちょ）する事態を招いている」と述べた。

買い手を呼び込むために値下げを実施した建設業者は４３％と、２０─２６年の期間で最も高い割合となった。平均値下げ幅は６％と横ばいだった。販売促進策の実施率は６５％。１９カ月連続で６０％以上となっている。 

現在の販売状況を示す指数は２ポイント低下の３３。販売見通しを示す指数は５ポイント低下の３２となった。

見込み客の来場状況を示す指数は５ポイント低下の１８。ＮＡＨＢのチーフエコノミスト、ロバート・ディーツ氏は同指数について、コロナ禍の２０年４月を除くと、１２年４月以来の低水準だと指摘した。

items.title: Nvidia-backed Nscale, Anthropic in talks for new $45 billion AI cloud deal, source says
items.summary: Read more about Nvidia-backed Nscale, Anthropic in talks for new $45 billion AI cloud deal, source says on Devdiscourse ...
items.body:
Nvidia-backed Nscale, Anthropic in talks for new $45 billion AI cloud deal, source says
Reuters | Updated: 20-10-2026 03:13 IST | Created: 20-10-2026 03:13 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Nscale is in talks to sell AI computing power to Claude maker Anthropic in a new deal that could be worth about $45 billion, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.
The data center developer is seeking another major deal with the AI lab for a second facility at its Monarch data center campus in West Virginia, the person said. In August, Anthropic struck a deal to spend $45 billion to rent AI cloud computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus. A second Monarch building would deliver 460 megawatts of computing power using Nvidia's advanced Vera Rubin AI chips, according to the source.
Anthropic did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Anthropic also has the right of first refusal on Monarch's expected third building, the person said, adding discussions were ongoing and details of the plan could change.
Bloomberg, which first reported the news, also said a cohort of investors had urged Anthropic to lower its IPO valuation target after a series of market setbacks for AI companies. Investors have sharpened scrutiny of companies that are increasingly turning to debt-driven AI infrastructure expansion. Last week, Nscale rival CoreWeave's shares slumped amid concerns over its $50 billion debt load, fueling a global selloff in AI stocks.
The news of a potential tie-up comes after Microsoft pulled out of a deal to anchor a flagship data center for Nscale following power connection delays that pushed its expected supply date into the 2030s. Nscale has grown rapidly since launch, increasing its total contracted value from $100 million to more than $103 billion in two-and-a-half years and competing with Nebius , Crusoe and Lambda.
According to the Nscale prospectus, Microsoft and Anthropic are expected to be the company's major customers in the future.

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

[１９日 ロイター] - イランのアラグチ外相は１９日、ロシアのラブロフ外相との共同記者会見で、ホルムズ海峡の不安定化と緊張の高まりは米国に責任があるとの認識を示し、地域問題は外交を通じて解決されなければならないと述べた。

アラグチ氏は「外国勢力の駐留を伴わず、地域内部から安全保障を実現するあらゆる取り組みを歓迎する。それが正しい方向性だと考えている」と述べ、地域諸国に対し共同の安全保障体制の構築に向けて取り組むよう呼びかけた。

ロシアのラブロフ外相はアラグチ氏との会談で、ロシアはエネルギー価格の大幅な変動に利益を見いだしていないとし、ロシアは長期的な視点で経済と国家の発展を計画する必要があると述べた。

items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１９日　ロイター］ - １９日午前の米国株式市場では、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が上昇した。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株が前週の急落から反発したほか、原油価格の下落も支援材料となった。ナスダック総合指数は一時２５５．３ポイント（０．９８％）上昇した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手がけるコアウィーブは、投資判断の引き上げを受けて３．４％高と急伸した。

ゴールドマン・サックスは、同社の投資判断を「中立」から「買い」に引き上げた。コンピューティング能力の供給が逼迫していることや、競合企業に対する業績面での優位性から、今後２年間でメガワット当たりの年間経常収益が押し上げられるはずだとし、直近の下落は買いの好機だとした。前週には、同社の抱える５００億ドルの債務を巡る懸念がＡＩセクター全体に広がり、株価の４分の１超を失っていた。

競合のネビウス・グループは４．５％高。過去２週間で３１％超下落していた。データセンター運営のアプライド・デジタルは９％、ＩＲＥＮは５．７％、それぞれ上昇した。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は２．８％高で推移。前週に１１％超下落し、ＡＩ関連の急落局面で最も打撃を受けた銘柄群の一つとなった。

インテルは５．６％上昇した。ＪＰモルガンが投資判断を「アンダーウエート」から「ニュートラル」に引き上げたことが材料となった。

エヌビディアは０．６％、ＡＭＤは４．３％、ブロードコムは２．２％、それぞれ上昇した。３社とも前週に大きく売られていた。

マイクロン・テクノロジーは３．８％高。前週には約１５％下落していた。データストレージのサンディスク、ウエスタン・デジタル、シーゲイトも前週の大幅安から反発した。

Ex-OpenAI employee accused of planting device appears to have Saudi backing, US prosecutors say

A handout photo shows what the US Justice Department says is Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national employed as an OpenAI engineer, checking a hidden audio recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company, at a location given as San Francisco, California, US, October 5, 2026. FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : An ex-OpenAI engineer accused of planting a recording device in an executive conference room at the AI company appears to have received considerable support from the Saudi government, US prosecutors said in a court filing.
Federal prosecutors allege that the defendant, Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, was in frequent communication with an unnamed member of the Saudi royal family and that a Saudi military official paid for a one-way plane ticket for Alfozan's wife and young son to return to Saudi Arabia after his arrest, according to the court document, made public late on Sunday.
Prosecutors made those allegations as they asked a federal judge to keep Alfozan in US custody to await trial, arguing he is a flight risk. Alfozan, a Saudi national and lawful permanent resident in the US, is scheduled to appear in federal court in San Francisco later on Monday. 
The case has highlighted security challenges around sensitive AI research as companies and governments compete fiercely for an edge in the transformational technology.

"The defendant went to significant lengths to create customized, encrypted recording devices to secretly record highly sensitive meetings involving senior OpenAI personnel and executives, high-level business counterparts, and government officials, all while communicating with individuals of significance in Saudi Arabia and pursuing opportunities in — and making plans to travel to — Saudi Arabia," prosecutors wrote in a detention memo.
The Saudi government media office did not immediately respond to a request for comment. A lawyer for Alfozan did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The lawyer, William Pernik, previously asked for Alfozan to be released from custody, subject to conditions including location monitoring and surrendering his passport, and said Alfozan had spent the last 15 years in the US and had applied to become a citizen.
The lawyer said a planned trip by Alfozan to Saudi Arabia this month was booked before he was under investigation and was for "family and immigration reasons," according to a court filing.
DEVICE INSTALLED BEHIND TV
US prosecutors charged Alfozan last week with using an electronic device to intercept oral communications. Alfozan plugged a recording device into the back of a television in an executive conference room at one of OpenAI's San Francisco buildings, according to a criminal complaint.
Meetings involving government officials took place in the conference room around the time the device was installed, according to the prosecutors' detention memo. 
Prosecutors said the investigation remains active and additional charges could be brought against Alfozan.
A member of the Saudi royal family sought to recruit Alfozan for an AI-focused role in Saudi Arabia, writing in one message, “Saudi needs you more then the US!" Alfozan replied "100," according to messages cited by prosecutors.
Before his arrest, Alfozan was scheduled to fly to Riyadh during a planned two-month parental leave. His wife told investigators that she and their son planned to move permanently to Saudi Arabia and that Alfozan eventually intended to join them, according to prosecutors.
In an Arabic-language interview on the Identity Capital podcast last month, Alfozan said that he visits Saudi Arabia three or four times a year, follows developments there and advises or mentors Saudi startups.
He said meeting Prince Mohammed bin Salman, then deputy crown prince, during a 2016 gathering with young Saudi tech workers in Silicon Valley persuaded him to learn at a top tech company before bringing those skills back home.
While Alfozan was working at Facebook, he and other Saudis in Silicon Valley formed a consulting initiative that linked Saudi public- and private-sector organizations with expertise in big data, the internet of things and machine learning.
OpenAI previously said it discovered the device on September 30 and referred the matter to the FBI.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米、中国ディープシークを民生部門ＩＴから排除　情報流出懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　１９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　１９日　ロイター] - 米国土安全保障省（ＤＨＳ）は、米政府の民生部門のＩＴシステムから、中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークの製品および同社製モデルを使用した第三者サービスの排除を命じている。１９日に公表された通知から明らかになった。 

同省はまた、米政府の民生部門によるディープシーク製品およびディープシークを用いて開発された第三者サービスの調達も禁止する。同省は、ディープシークのモデルは「複数の脅威の経路」をもたらすと指摘。米政府職員や取引業者が使用した場合、「機密データが中国に流出する可能性がある」との懸念を示した。

さらに、政府機関によるディープシークの利用は「米国民や政府機関に関し、具体的な工作につながる機密情報を生み出す可能性がある。モデル自体にマルウエアやその他のセキュリティー上の脆弱性が含まれている恐れがある」と指摘した。

ＤＨＳは１９日に公表された７月付のメモで、ディープシークに関する潜在的なリスクに対処するため、政府ウェブサイトを出入りするトラフィックの流れを監視するよう連邦機関に指示した。

これまでに米商務省や海軍を含む複数の機関が、政府支給の端末でのディープシークの使用を禁止しているほか、ニューヨーク、テネシー、バージニア各州など複数の州も同様の措置を講じている。

在ワシントンの中国大使館はコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 19 : Nvidia has won central processor chip business with another fast-growing AI startup that until now relied entirely on chips from Intel and AMD, an early sign that its push into a market long controlled by those two rivals has traction.
Modal, a cloud-computing startup that rents out computing power to AI developers, said it plans to start using Nvidia's new Vera central processor for the first time for hosting agents, the AI systems that can carry out long-running tasks for human users. Modal until now has run such work only on Intel and AMD chips.
Modal last week raised $750 million in a funding round led by Accel at a $15.75 billion valuation, saying it is on track to record $1 billion in sales over the next year. Modal said usage of its services has tripled and revenue has grown more than 15 times year-over-year.
Modal said Monday that early tests showed the new Nvidia chip doubled the amount of work that AI agents can get done, prompting the company to support Nvidia's chip design for the first time, which will require some deep software changes on Modal's side.

But Chief Executive Erik Bernhardsson was careful to stress it is not abandoning its existing suppliers. The company said it will run the Nvidia chips alongside its current Intel and AMD offerings in a mixed fleet, putting each job on whatever hardware runs it best.
Bernhardsson said the tests were run against the Intel and AMD chips already on the market. Both Nvidia rivals are developing newer models that could narrow the gap with Nvidia.
"We'll test them when they're available," he said, adding that running a mixed setup means the company "can always deploy whatever hardware performs best."
Nvidia has told investors it expects to generate at least $20 billion from Vera chip sales this fiscal year, its opening bid for a market it values at roughly $200 billion. Nvidia has previously said OpenAI, Anthropic and Oracle also plan to use the chips, along with AI startups such as Perplexity.

items.title: パリやニースなどに夜間外出禁止令、首相が極左勢力の暴動関与を非難
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ １９日 ロイター] - フランス当局は１９日、首都パリや北部リール、南部ニースなど複数の都市の一部地域に夜間外出禁止令を発令した。週末に行われた全国的なデモが暴動や略奪に発展し、政府は治安対策の不備を巡って対応を迫られている。

ルコルニュ首相は、一部地域で夜間外出禁止令を出すよう地方当局に要請していた。首相は、パリ全域を対象とする全面的な夜間外出禁止令は否定したが、非常事態宣言については排除しなかった。ただ、現段階では部分的かつ地域限定の夜間外出禁止令の方がより適切との考えを示していた。 

パリ警察によると、首都の一部地域で１９日午後８時（１８００ＧＭＴ、日本時間２０日午前３時）からデモを禁止する命令を出したほか、レピュブリック広場とレアールの周辺で午後１１時から夜間外出禁止令を発令した。いずれも２０日午前６時まで適用される。警察は声明で「これらの措置の厳格な順守を確保するため、警察部隊を配置している」と表明した。

首相府関係者によると、北部のリール、ドゥエー、ワティニー、ドゥナンでは、各市長の同意を得て、未成年者を対象に午後８時から翌朝午前６時までの夜間外出禁止令を２日間にわたり実施する。

ニースのエリック・シオッティ市長はインターネットに投稿した動画で、市中心部で未成年者の夜間外出を禁止する命令に署名したと述べた。

マルセイユは集会とデモを禁止した。一方、フランスの労働組合は１１月５日に新たなストライキと集会を実施するよう呼びかけた。

数週間にわたる学生デモに続き、１７日には、生活費の高騰と公共サービスの質の低下に抗議するデモが一部で暴徒化し、過去数十年で同国最大規模の暴動に発展した。

商業・小売連盟によると、週末に被害を受けた店舗は約３０００店に上っている。 

次期大統領選まで半年に迫るフランスを揺るがし、経済の低迷と債務の急増による圧力を浮き彫りにした。

＜首相、極左を非難＞

またルコルニュ首相は、今回の騒乱の一部について極左グループの関与を非難。「大統領選を前に、国内に深刻な混乱を引き起こそうとする極左の動きが確かに存在する。これ以上強い言い方はできない」と述べた。 

これに対し、極左政党「不屈のフランス（ＬＦＩ）」を率いるジャンリュック・メランション氏は強く反発。ルコルニュ首相に対し証拠を示すよう求め、「さもなくば謝罪し、沈黙し、騒乱の火に油を注ぐのをやめるべきだ」とＸに投稿した。 

フランス大統領選の世論調査では、メランション氏と極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏が他の候補者に対するリードを広げ、決選投票で一騎打ちになるとの見通しが示されている。

週末の暴動や略奪の爪痕が残る中、フランスの主要都市の市長らは１９日、治安部隊の準備が不足していたとして政府に説明を求めた。

パリ、マルセイユ、リヨンの市長は仏紙リベラシオンへの共同寄稿で、デモや抗議行動への対応には慣れているとしながらも、「１７日には初めて、われわれの都市の広い範囲が保護されずに放置されたと感じた」と記した。

１９日から学校の休暇が始まることで事態が落ち着く可能性はあるが、パリ中心部のルーブル美術館やパリ政治学院などでは、学生が集会や封鎖を続けていた。

Erlangen, GERMANY, Oct 19 : AI could help preserve manufacturing jobs in high-wage countries such as Germany by boosting factory automation to as much as 80 per cent, Siemens executive board member Cedrik Neike said on Monday.
Speaking at the company's electronics plant in Erlangen, Neike said manufacturers need annual productivity gains of 7 per cent-9 per cent to remain competitive.
• Siemens aims to harness AI to raise the level of automation in factory manufacturing to 70 per cent-80 per cent from 30 per cent-40 per cent currently, Neike said.
• Siemens and Nvidia are working on the use of "physical AI" in manufacturing, using digital twins and AI models to simulate and optimise factory operations before they are deployed on the factory floor.

items.title: 米ロ中首脳、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議に合わせ会談の可能性＝ロシア大統領報道官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ　１９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ　１９日　ロイター] - ロシアのペスコフ大統領報道官は１９日、プーチン大統領、トランプ米大統領、中国の習近平国家主席が来月中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に合わせて３者会談を行う可能性があるとの見方を示し、そうした会談について協議で言及されたと明らかにした。

ペスコフ大統領報道官は、ロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた協議を行うため、プーチン氏が米ロ中の首脳会談を提案したとする米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）の報道について質問され、「３首脳全員が中国で開かれる首脳会議に参加する可能性があることを踏まえ、そうした会談の可能性が実際に話題に上った」とした上で、「実際に議題に上ったが、会談そのものや会談の議題、内容について具体的な提案や合意が協議されたり、提示されたりしていない」と述べた。

また、米国はロシアとウクライナの戦闘終結に向けた仲介努力を続けており、ロシアはその取り組みを評価していると指摘。最終的な和平合意にはウクライナの参加が不可欠との認識を示した。

米ロ中首脳会談の可能性についてルビオ米国務長官は１９日、訪問先のウズベキスタンで記者団に対し「会談の話は出ている。最終決定したかどうかは分からないが、トランプ大統領の意向は明確だ。大統領はウクライナとロシア間の戦争が終わることを望んでいる」と述べている。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は、米ロ中の首脳による会談の構想を非難。「ウクライナ、米国、ロシアの首脳による３者会談なら、戦争終結の早期実現の一助になり得る。ロシア、中国、米国の首脳による３者会談はその逆の効果しかなく、プーチン氏が戦争を継続することを後押しするだけだ」とＸに投稿した。

items.title: イエメン暫定政府の訓練施設攻撃で58人死亡、フーシ派が犯行声明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [１９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[１９日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は１９日、同国中南部シャブワ州にある暫定政府治安部隊の訓練施設を攻撃し、５８人が死亡、２００人以上が負傷した。地元当局が明らかにした。貧困にあえぐ同国での戦闘が激化している。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリー報道官はＸへの投稿で、同派が訓練施設を標的にしたと表明。同施設はサウジアラビア軍が運営していたと主張した。サウジ当局はコメント要請に即座には応じなかった。

匿名を条件に取材に応じた地元当局筋によると、フーシ派は訓練中の治安部隊に向け、弾道ミサイル３発を発射した。シャブワ州はイエメン中南部沿岸に位置するエネルギー資源が豊富な州で、同国最大の産業投資であるバルハフ液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）施設がある。

イエメン暫定政府軍は今月、フーシ派が支配する地域の奪還を目指す作戦を開始し、バベルマンデブ海峡付近の領土を取り戻した。一方、フーシ派は、イエメン南部山岳地帯における反フーシ派勢力の最後の主要都市拠点であるタイズを包囲している。

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : Meta apologized for suspending the Instagram account of the "No Kings" protest movement over the weekend, attributing the shutdown to a sharp increase in activity that looked like automated bot traffic rather than human exchanges.
Demonstrators gathered at thousands of events across the United States on Saturday decrying President Donald Trump's aggressive deportation efforts, war in Iran and other policies in the third round of the "No Kings" rallies.
The Instagram account used by organizers and attendees, however, was offline for more than an hour. And Meta spokesman Andy Stone wrote in a post on X that it took longer to fix problems with organizers' access to the accounts. 
Stone said network security systems detected the use of a Claude tool reading profiles, posts, and hashtags, with the rate sharply increasing in intense bursts on October 17.

"These abrupt, high-volume, sequential requests in a short period resembled automated bot traffic rather than an ordinary human browsing our systems. This activity caused our automated protections to incorrectly take the No Kings Instagram account offline," he said.
"We want to reiterate our sincere apology for the error."
Rally organizers were not satisfied on Monday.
"Meta's explanation still doesn't add up," the No Kings Coalition said on the Bluesky platform. "Beyond shutting down our Instagram, we’ve received reports that NoKings and early voting content was inaccessible, restricted, or seemed suppressed across Meta platforms." 
"Weeks before an election, an apology isn't enough. The public needs answers, accountability, and concrete safeguards," the coalition said.
"No Kings" rallies took place in cities from Seattle and San Diego to Chicago, Atlanta and New York. In Washington, DC, protesters gathered at the site of Trump's proposed triumphal arch to encourage early voting before the November 3 midterm congressional elections.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 19 : The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a challenge by Alphabet's Google to a US Patent and Trademark Office rule that the company argued has insulated older patents from validity reviews and helped fuel a surge in patent litigation.
The justices turned away Google's appeal of a lower court's decision not to force the agency to reconsider, without using its "settled expectations" rule, the company's challenge to the validity of a patent held by software company VirtaMove. VirtaMove accused Google of infringing the patent.
Google asked the Supreme Court to review the "settled expectations" policy, under which the patent office's Patent Trial and Appeal Board, or PTAB, became more likely to reject requests to review patents that have been in force for more than six years.
Technology companies often use the board's "inter partes review" process to try to cancel patents that they are accused of infringing. The three most active board petitioners between 2020 and 2025 were Samsung, Apple and Alphabet, according to a report from IP company Patexia.

The USPTO during President Donald Trump's administration has introduced measures that have decreased the percentage of reviews the board takes up. 
That figure fell to 37 per cent in 2026 under John Squires, the Trump appointee who heads the patent office, compared to 65 per cent under his predecessor Kathi Vidal, who was appointed by former President Joe Biden, according to an April report from the agency.
The patent office outlined in a memo last year several factors that favor rejecting an inter partes review petition, which the agency has used to deny review for patents that are more than six years old based on the "settled expectations" of the parties.
The patent office cited the "settled expectations" rule in rejecting Google's review petition in 2025 concerning the VirtaMove patent involving server software. The US Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit ruled against Google's appeal of the patent office rejection.
Google told the justices in a filing that the rule exceeds the patent office's authority by creating an artificial time limit for board petitions.
"The PTO (Patent and Trademark Office) has no authority to create a limitations period where Congress did not, and it has no authority to expand patent rights beyond what Congress provided," Google said in the filing.
The Trump administration urged the court not to hear Google's appeal.
A group of companies including Google, Apple and Intel has filed a separate lawsuit challenging a related patent office policy. The Federal Circuit ruled against the companies in February, and Intel and Google have also asked the Supreme Court to hear that case.

Source: Reuters

items.title: US banning Chinese AI DeepSeek from government agency IT systems
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: The US Homeland Security Department is ordering the removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services using the Chinese AI model from US civilian agency IT systems, according to a notice published Monday.
items.body:
The US Homeland Security Department is ordering the removal of DeepSeek products and third-party services using the Chinese AI model from US civilian agency IT systems, according to a notice published Monday.
The department is also banning acquisition of DeepSeek products and third-party services developed using DeepSeek by US civilian government agencies. DHS said DeepSeek models pose "multiple threat vectors" and raised concerns that use of the product "may result in the transfer of sensitive data to the PRC if used by US government employees or vendors."
DHS also said use of DeepSeek by government agencies "could produce actionable intelligence on US persons and/or government agencies. The models themselves may contain malware or other security vulnerabilities."
In a July memo made public Monday, DHS told federal agencies to monitor flows of traffic in and out of government websites to address potential risks from DeepSeek.
Previously, several US agencies, including the Department of Commerce and the Navy, have banned the use of DeepSeek on government devices. Multiple states including New York, Tennessee, and Virginia have taken similar steps.
The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately comment.
The Trump administration has taken a series of steps to crack down on Chinese tech companies.
The Federal Communications Commission will vote on October 29 to bar all Chinese labs from testing electronic devices such as smartphones, cameras and computers for use in the US. Last year, 82% of US electronics were tested in China.
In December, the FCC banned import of all new models of Chinese drones and also banned imports of new models of Chinese-made consumer routers, the boxes connecting computers, phones and smart devices to the internet.
In July, the FCC voted to bar sales of devices in the US that contain key hardware from Chinese companies deemed to be national security risks and has proposed to prohibit US telecommunications carriers from interconnecting with Chinese telecom firms deemed national security risks.

LONDON, Oct 19 : Britain risks becoming a "high-value AI customer" rather than a country able to shape the technology unless it takes urgent action to build domestic capabilities, the government's top science advisers said on Monday.
Governments around the world are racing to build AI capabilities, driven by concerns that countries without their own expertise, computing infrastructure and models could become increasingly dependent on a handful of mostly U.S.-based companies that dominate the technology.
The Council for Science and Technology, an independent advisory body that advises the government on science and technology policy, said decisions made now would determine whether Britain captures the economic and public benefits of AI while maintaining resilience and strategic autonomy.
"The way for us to achieve AI sovereignty is to build trusted systems that deliver real public, economic and security benefits," the advisers said in an emailed letter to the AI minister, Kanishka Narayan.

The council warned that Britain was at risk of falling behind and becoming a "high-value AI customer, rather than a country able to shape the technology and its usage," without what it described as "deliberate and urgent action."
It recommended appointing a single government lead to coordinate AI sovereignty policy, investing in skills, data and computing infrastructure, and testing AI systems in areas including national security, health and education.
The advisers also said Britain should maintain access to the world's most advanced AI systems while developing some domestic capabilities of its own, including exploring a publicly governed British AI model that could be made available to researchers, startups and public services.
The government did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

items.summary: The civil unrest has plunged President Emmanuel Macron’s final months in office deeper into turmoil, exposing the powerlessness of a leader struggling to contain social anger with scant political capital and a fragile grip on public order.
items.body:
France’s worst bout of civil unrest in years has plunged President Emmanuel Macron’s final months in office deeper into [USN:FWN4630KA TEXT:"turmoil"], exposing the powerlessness of a leader struggling to contain social anger with little money to spend, scant political capital and an increasingly fragile grip on public order.
The [USN:L1N46302B TEXT:"rioting"] that swept across France on Saturday, leaving a trail of looted shops, torched buildings and defaced public institutions, presents Macron with perhaps the most explosive challenge of his twilight presidency: a country demanding more from a state that can no longer afford to give much.
Macron came to power almost a decade ago promising to upend France’s sclerotic political class, turbocharge economic reforms and restore authority through a more assertive presidency. Instead, with just six months left in office, he finds himself effectively a lame-duck head of state presiding over a country mired in political paralysis, facing acute [USN:L6N46502R TEXT:"financial pressures"] and grappling with unrest that has exposed the limits of state authority.
Unlike during the Yellow Vest uprising of 2018-2019, when Macron sought to defuse public anger with billions of euros in concessions, France’s strained public finances and fractured parliament leave him with precious few levers to pull.
Even former allies are now openly scathing, tracing the country's current impasse to Macron's decision to call a [USN:L8N3J00J1 TEXT:"snap parliamentary election"] in 2024 that weakened his authority.
“The end of this term is a slow agony,” said Loïc Kervran, a former lawmaker from Macron’s camp, on X. “The president paralysed the country with his absurd decision to dissolve parliament in 2024. Arguably the worst decision in the history of the Fifth Republic."
LE PEN'S 'HIGHWAY' TO THE PRESIDENCY The turmoil may benefit far-right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen, who is already the frontrunner in the 2027 presidential race and stands to gain from both the anger over declining living standards and the fears over law and order unleashed by the weekend’s violence.
"Le Pen no longer needs to spend any money to campaign," Jean-Baptiste Moreau, another former Macron lawmaker, told Reuters. "It's not just a clear path ahead of her — it's a six-lane highway."
Le Pen delivered her own message to the nation in a video statement on Sunday, portraying Macron's administration as a crumbling power and casting herself as the figure capable of restoring order.
When Macron later addressed the country, he offered little concrete action, stopping short of declaring a state of emergency. As he spoke, looting was continuing for a second consecutive night, including in affluent Paris districts, prompting his prime minister Sébastien Lecornu to announce local curfews on Monday.
Opponents and one-time allies alike were underwhelmed. His former prime minister, Edouard Philippe, now preparing his own presidential run, was unsparing in his criticism.
"Mr President, I listened to you last night," he wrote on X. "I would have preferred, like millions of French people, decisions and initiatives to restore order."
"Our country needs to be commanded," he added.
But even Philippe is struggling to shake off his past association with Macron, and most recent polls show far-left firebrand Jean-Luc Melenchon edging ahead of him in the race to qualify for the second-round runoff vote. That outcome would all but guarantee a Le Pen victory, according to opinion polls.
CALLS FOR EARLY RESIGNATION AMID MULTIPLE CRISES Macron's office on Monday announced that he had refused his interior minister's resignation and ordered a review into apparent failures in intelligence gathering and police preparedness — deepening the impression of a government struggling to regain control.
[USN:L1N465097 TEXT:"Investors also took fright"]. Market analysts say the violence adds another layer of political risk at a time when France is already under scrutiny over its swelling debt burden and struggle to reduce one of the euro zone's largest budget deficits.
The president now finds himself trapped between bond markets demanding spending restraint and protesters demanding the opposite.
Despite calls from opponents to remain in France, Macron arrived in Kuwait on Monday on a Gulf tour he says will help secure fuel supplies and ease some of the economic pressures that have helped swell the ranks of the protesters.
The trip carries risks, reinforcing perceptions of a president disconnected from the public mood. Images of Macron attending a Céline Dion concert with his wife Brigitte on Friday evening, hours before the unrest erupted, prompted ridicule on social media and became an easy symbol for critics seeking to portray him as detached from events.
In a sign of the depth of disenchantment in parts of his political camp, some former allies have begun openly discussing whether he should leave office before the end of his term. Moreau, who spoke to Macron on Sunday, said he urged him to prepare an orderly early departure to break the current political deadlock and avoid another six months of drift.
"He doesn't want to give up, that's not his character. But that's what he should do for the country," he said.

items.title: ジャカルタ株が過去2日で最大の下落、ＭＳＣＩに説明要求　市場改革も表明
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ankur Banerjee　Stefanno Sulaiman

[シンガポール／ジャカルタ １９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ankur Banerjee　Stefanno Sulaiman

[シンガポール／ジャカルタ １９日 ロイター] - インドネシア株式市場は１９日、２営業日の下落としては過去最大を記録した。指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩが１６日、２０２７年に同国を「新興国市場」から除外する可能性を警告したことが売りを誘発。当局はＭＳＣＩに説明を求めた。

ジャカルタ総合指数は１６日に１１．６％急落したのに続き、１９日は３．６％安で取引を終えた。２営業日の下落率は１９９８年のアジア金融危機時を含め過去最大となった。取引時間中には６年ぶりの安値も付けた。

ＭＳＣＩが１６日、インドネシアを「新興国市場」から「スタンドアローン市場」に変更することを検討していると表明したことで売りが始まった。想定以上に厳しい分類変更の可能性に、投資家や当局者に動揺が広がった。

スタンドアローン市場に変更されれば、東南アジア最大の経済規模を持つインドネシアは国際資本へのアクセスを失い、投資先として周縁に追いやられる恐れがある。

不安心理からの売りは通貨や債券市場にも波及した。ルピアは１ドル＝１万８０３０ルピアに下落、６月に付けた過去最安値の１万８１９０ルピアに迫った。国債も下落し、１０年債利回りは１６日の７．１６９％から７．４％に上昇した。

インドネシア証券取引所のジェフリー・ヘンドリック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、説明を求めるためのＭＳＣＩとの会合を前に「（ＭＳＣＩから）このような発表があるとは予想していなかった。予想外の声明で市場はパニックに陥った」と述べた。

＜資本市場改革への取り組み継続＞

ヘンドリック氏はＭＳＣＩとのオンライン会合後、１月にＭＳＣＩが最初の警告を発したことを受けて着手した資本市場改革に引き続き取り組むと述べた。会合の詳細は明らかにできないとした。

同氏はまた、市場の透明性と価格発見機能を改善するための２つの施策を発表した。同一の個人や法人に株式保有が高度に集中している銘柄をジャカルタ総合指数から除外する措置が含まれる。「主要指数の動きをより正確に示す」ことが狙いという。

インドネシア証券取引所（ＩＤＸ）は１９日、価格変動の抑制に向け、株価の１日の下落率の上限を１５％から７％に縮小した。それを下回る価格での売り注文を自動的に拒否し、一段の下落を防ぐ。

＜投資家、インドネシア資産への投資を再評価＞

ＭＳＣＩの動きを受け、投資家がインドネシア資産全般への投資を見直す中、規制当局や財政・金融当局への圧力が強まっている。

かつて新興国市場の有望な投資先だった同国からの資本逃避リスクへの懸念も高まった。投資家によると、新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック以降、プラボウォ大統領の下で財政の健全性や中央銀行の独立性への信頼が薄れる中、同国の魅力は既に低下していた。

事情に詳しい政府当局者２人によると、プラボウォ氏は１９日、財政・金融当局者と会合を開き、「現在の経済情勢」について協議した。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・レーティングのソブリン担当アナリスト、レイン・リン氏は、ＭＳＣＩの最新の警告で追加の資本流出が起きる可能性が高いものの、資金調達コストを大幅に押し上げる規模にはならないとの見方を示した。「より懸念されるのは、投資家の信頼が損なわれる可能性と、国債市場や海外直接投資にも投資家心理の悪化が広く波及するリスクだ」と述べた。

ゴールドマン・サックスは、ＭＳＣＩ指数から完全に除外されれば、パッシブ運用資金が５６億ドル流出する可能性があると推計。これらの指数をベンチマークとするアクティブ運用ファンドの保有額は８０億ドルを超えるものの、売却するかどうかは指数への連動ではなく、運用者の裁量によると記した。

海外投資家は２６年に入り、インドネシア株を４９億８０００万ドル売り越している。年間の資金流出額は少なくとも過去１６年で最大となるペースだ。

Carrier loaded with Qatari LNG makes rare Red Sea journey to get gas to Europe

The transit, which comes as European natural gas prices hit highest level in 4 yrs, is unusual. Commercial vessels have increasingly tended to take long detours to avoid the Red Sea.

Stephen Stapczynski

19 October, 2026 06:34 pm IST

QatarEnergy's LNG production facilities in Ras Laffan Industrial City, Qatar on 2 March 2026 | Reuters/File Photo

Follow Us :

Text Size:

-->

A carrier loaded with Qatari liquefied natural gas is sailing north through the Red Sea, potentially speeding up delivery to European customers with a rare transit through waters vulnerable to renewed attacks from Houthi rebels.

The tanker, which loaded an LNG cargo in Qatar in August, is signaling Poland as its next destination, according to ship-tracking data compiled by Bloomberg. Poland’s Orlen SA has a long-term supply contract with QatarEnergy, though shipments under the deal were canceled after the exporter’s giant Ras Laffan plant was hit by drone strikes in March.

The transit — which comes as European natural gas prices hit the highest level in almost four years — is unusual. Commercial vessels have increasingly tended to take long detours to avoid the Red Sea, typically sailing around Africa’s Cape of Good Hope to head to Europe, a route that can add almost two weeks and extra costs to a one-way journey.

Show Full Article

UK Maritime Trade Operations, a security outfit which links commercial shipping and military forces, reported on Saturday that an unnamed LNG tanker was approached southeast of the Yemeni port of Al Mukalla, in the Gulf of Aden, by a skiff that fired two shots. The tanker’s security team fired two shots in return.

UKMTO did not provide further details, though ship-tracking data suggest the Poland-bound carrier was the only LNG tanker in the region at the time. The data suggests the vessel has since continued its journey.

QatarEnergy did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Continued disruption around the Strait of Hormuz has tightened global LNG supply for months, driving up prices and forcing Middle Eastern suppliers to look for workarounds.

This latest Qatari cargo is heading to Europe at a time when the continent has struggled to refill its gas inventories ahead of winter. Reserves of the fuel are sitting at the lowest seasonal level in over a decade, threatening even higher prices as temperatures begin to drop.

items.title: Norway targets 'harmful' social media, games with under-16 ban
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Norway's planned social media ban for children will include provisions targeting "harmful platforms", the government said on Monday, naming messaging and gaming services Roblox, Snapchat and TikTok among those affected.
items.body:
Norway's planned social media ban for children will include provisions targeting "harmful platforms", the government said on Monday, naming messaging and gaming services Roblox, Snapchat and TikTok among those affected.
The Nordic country [USN:L8N41706W TEXT:"said in April"] it would present a bill in parliament by the end of the year to ban children from using social media until they turn 16, making technology companies responsible for age verification. It did not name any platforms at the time.
Several European nations are seeking to rein in children's social media use after Australia took the lead with the [USN:L1N3YG0A5 TEXT:"world's first ban"] on under-16s last December, which included apps such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat and YouTube.
Norway's government said in a statement on Monday that its bill was intended to address the full range of risks children face on social media and that it would affect "many platforms".
"This includes everything from exposure to harmful content and addictive features to illegal marketing and unwanted contact from strangers," Children and Families Minister Lene Vaagslid said in the statement.
The planned legislation provides tech companies with an incentive to remove harmful content and addictive features, she said.
The ministry went on to define what it called harmful platforms as "social media that, through its design, features or content, poses a risk to children's emotional, cognitive or physical development or safety."
"The government believes that platforms such as TikTok, Roblox, and Snapchat will be covered by the law," it said.
It did not immediately respond to a question about which other apps could be affected.
Snap Inc (SNAP.N) , Roblox Corporation (RBLX.N) and TikTok owner ByteDance did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Children and young people will still have access to messaging services and games that are deemed harmless, the ministry said.

items.title: Ballooning global imbalances risk amplifying messy AI unwind: McGeever
items.author: Jamie McGeever
items.creator: Jamie McGeever
items.summary: Global imbalances are expanding, with the US trade deficit on one side and outsized Asian surpluses on the other posing growing risks to economies and markets worldwide. AI lies at the heart of it.
items.body:
[USN:L8N40Q1EP TEXT:"Global imbalances"] are expanding, with the US trade deficit on one side and outsized Asian surpluses on the other posing growing risks to economies and markets worldwide. AI lies at the heart of it.
The US [USN:L1N45R0RR TEXT:"trade deficit"] widened in August to $105.6 billion, a 17-month high. This was thanks to a 4.3% surge in imports to an all-time high of $420.8 billion as companies sucked in the computer chips, equipment and materials needed for the record-busting AI buildout. A Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis paper in August estimated that around 70% of US firms’ AI-related capital spending is on imported goods.
Many of these shipments are coming from a handful of countries in Asia, such as South Korea, Taiwan and China, whose trade surpluses have exploded to historic heights in recent months. [USN:P8N44H02I TEXT:"China's exports"] this year have leapt by 22%.
Economists at Barclays estimate that semiconductors and automatic data-processing equipment and parts account for almost two-thirds of that. The contribution of AI-related goods to South Korea and Taiwan's export boom is even greater. [USN:L1N45K03J TEXT:"South Korea's"] exports jumped 83.5% in September from a year earlier as semiconductor shipments more than tripled, while Taiwan's surplus in September hit $23.6 billion, a monthly record.
Given these unrelenting flows, China is well on course to record a second consecutive annual trade surplus of over $1 trillion this year, while South Korea and Taiwan could post a combined $1 trillion current account surplus next year, according to Brad Setser at the Council on Foreign Relations.
The combined Asian surpluses are, for the most part, being recycled into US assets, mostly stocks, as overseas investors chase the pots of gold at the end of the American AI rainbow.
These widening external balances are ringing alarm bells. Officials from the International Monetary Fund and other international institutions warn that imbalances can distort asset prices and inflate financial bubbles, a dynamic that many analysts argue is already playing out. The consequences of a rapid, disorderly unwind could be extreme, potentially including a sharp depreciation of the US dollar, huge volatility on Wall Street, and a sudden spike in global interest rates. Last week’s ructions in global equities may have been a sneak peek.
FLOWING TO THE STREET US trade deficits and sky-high Asian exports are nothing new, but what’s changed in recent years is where the surpluses are flowing.
In years gone by, Asia's surpluses were typically reinvested into US Treasuries as Asian central banks sought to build their foreign currency reserves. As a result, US bond yields were capped, US consumer demand was propped up, and economies on both sides of the divide kept growing.
But those surpluses are now flowing into Wall Street.
Treasury International Capital (TIC) data on Friday showed that foreign investors' net purchases of US securities in August jumped to $279.2 billion, a record amount for a single month. The vast majority of that came from the private sector, with more than half of it plowed into equities, with the overseas private sector buying $131.9 billion of stocks, the second-biggest inflow on record behind June's $144.7 billion. Foreign private-sector net inflows into US stocks in the 12 months through August stood at $844 billion, up more than 30% from a year earlier.
Investment is also flooding into the US corporate debt market, where issuance from hyperscalers and others involved in the AI buildout has rocketed. Foreign purchases of US corporate bonds in the 12 months through August totaled $464 billion, also up more than 30% on the year.
Everyone, it seems, wants in on the AI mania.
Of course, this concentration heightens the risk of a disorderly exit when these markets turn. We already got glimpses of that last week. The Philadelphia chip index (.SOX) fell on Friday for the eighth straight day, marking its longest losing streak since October 2008. The index shed 11.5% last week.
Meanwhile, many of the bonds issued to fund the construction of data centers have recently dipped into distressed territory below 80 cents on the dollar.
"In a severe scenario, we could see a market correction that cascades through the highly leveraged and circular AI ecosystem. Given the sizable cross-border holdings of AI assets, the losses could spread around the world," IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva wrote last week.
If she’s right, the AI unwind could get ugly.
(The opinions expressed here are those of the author, a columnist for Reuters)

Elon Musk promises a SpaceX share to every child in the US next year

With roughly 72–73 million people under the age of 18 in the US, Musk’s one-time gift would be valued at about $10.5 to $10.7 billion as of now.

Himanshi Aggarwal

19 October, 2026 06:06 pm IST
